<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>BURN THE BROTHER — 8-Bit Story & Trial Hub</title>
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Press+Start+2P&family=Silkscreen:wght@400;700&display=swap');

  :root {
    --bg-outer: #090910;
    --panel-bg: #11111c;
    --panel-card: #161624;
    --border-dim: #2b2940;
    --border-mid: #434063;
    --gold: #f5b935;
    --gold-dark: #9c6f12;
    --text-main: #f4f3f8;
    --text-muted: #9b97b3;
    --green-ok: #4cd97b;
    --red-bad: #f0546a;
  }

  * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }

  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 100vh;
    background: var(--bg-outer);
    color: var(--text-main);
    font-family: 'Silkscreen', 'Courier New', monospace;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  .app-shell {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 500px;
    padding: 12px 12px 24px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  /* Header & Chapter Navigation */
  .top-header {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .brand-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .brand-title {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--gold);
    letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  }

  .brand-sq {
    width: 9px;
    height: 9px;
    background: var(--gold);
    box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(245, 185, 53, 0.6);
    display: inline-block;
  }

  .audio-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .nav-pills {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .pill-btn {
    background: var(--panel-card);
    color: #d6d3e6;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border-dim);
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-family: 'Silkscreen', monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
    padding: 5px 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: border-color 0.12s, background 0.12s, color 0.12s;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }

  .pill-btn:hover {
    border-color: var(--border-mid);
    color: #ffffff;
    background: #1d1c2e;
  }

  .pill-btn.active {
    background: var(--gold);
    color: #141008;
    border-color: #ffe08a;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .pill-btn.toggle-on {
    border-color: #425a80;
    background: #131c2b;
    color: #8cc4ff;
  }

  .pill-btn.toggle-off {
    border-color: var(--border-dim);
    background: #13131d;
    color: #77738f;
  }

  /* Main Stage Frame */
  .stage-frame {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    background: #07070c;
    border: 2px solid var(--border-mid);
    border-radius: 6px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75);
  }

  #mainCanvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    aspect-ratio: 260 / 210;
    image-rendering: -moz-crisp-edges;
    image-rendering: -webkit-crisp-edges;
    image-rendering: pixelated;
    image-rendering: crisp-edges;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: #050508;
  }

  #mainCanvas.tall-title {
    aspect-ratio: 260 / 316;
  }

  .scanlines {
    pointer-events: none;
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
      to bottom,
      rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px,
      rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 2px,
      rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) 2px,
      rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) 4px
    );
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.2s;
  }

  .scanlines.active {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  /* Story Dialogue Panel */
  .dialogue-panel {
    background: #0b0b12;
    border-top: 2px solid #f4f3f8;
    padding: 14px 16px 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
    min-height: 150px;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  .dialogue-panel.hidden {
    display: none;
  }

  .speaker-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--gold);
    letter-spacing: 0.7px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .speaker-label.fire-good {
    color: #ffae3b;
  }

  .speaker-label.fire-bad {
    color: #ff6374;
  }

  .dialogue-text {
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    color: #f6f5fa;
    min-height: 58px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .dialogue-footer {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 8px;
    padding-top: 6px;
    border-top: 1px solid #1e1c2e;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
  }

  .back-btn {
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-dim);
    color: #b7b3cc;
    font-family: 'Silkscreen', monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .back-btn:hover {
    border-color: var(--gold);
    color: #ffffff;
  }

  .next-hint {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    color: #c9c4de;
  }

  .blink-tri {
    color: var(--gold);
    animation: blinkAnim 0.9s steps(2, start) infinite;
  }

  @keyframes blinkAnim {
    50% { opacity: 0; }
  }

  /* Lucifer Choice Box */
  .lucifer-choices {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  .lucifer-opt {
    width: 100%;
    text-align: left;
    background: #131120;
    border: 1.5px solid #2f2b47;
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: #cfcbe0;
    font-family: 'Silkscreen', monospace;
    font-size: 13px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    transition: all 0.1s;
  }

  .lucifer-opt.selected,
  .lucifer-opt:hover {
    background: #221c33;
    border-color: var(--gold);
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(245, 185, 53, 0.35);
  }

  .lucifer-opt .opt-arrow {
    color: var(--gold);
  }

  /* Trials Hub View (Scene 7) */
  .trials-view {
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 14px;
    padding: 14px;
    background: #0c0c15;
  }

  .trials-view.active {
    display: flex;
  }

  .trials-topbar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .trials-hero {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 4px 6px 2px;
  }

  .trials-hero h2 {
    margin: 0 0 6px;
    font-size: 17px;
    color: var(--gold);
    letter-spacing: 1px;
  }

  .trials-hero p {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #cfcbe0;
  }

  .progress-strip {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 7px 10px;
    background: #131321;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-dim);
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #c2bdd6;
  }

  .badge-pill {
    padding: 2px 7px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 700;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-mid);
    background: #1b1a2b;
    color: #b5b0cc;
  }

  .badge-pill.cleared {
    background: rgba(76, 217, 123, 0.15);
    border-color: var(--green-ok);
    color: var(--green-ok);
  }

  .trial-card {
    background: #12121f;
    border: 2px solid var(--border-mid);
    border-radius: 6px;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    transition: border-color 0.15s;
  }

  .trial-card:hover {
    border-color: var(--gold);
  }

  .trial-card.cleared {
    border-color: var(--green-ok);
  }

  .trial-card-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 7px 10px;
    background: #0d0d17;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-dim);
    font-size: 10px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
  }

  .trial-tag {
    background: #241f36;
    color: #ffe08a;
    border: 1px solid #594b2d;
    padding: 2px 7px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .trial-preview-canvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    aspect-ratio: 240 / 190;
    image-rendering: pixelated;
    image-rendering: crisp-edges;
    background: #0b0b12;
  }

  .trial-card-body {
    padding: 12px 12px 10px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
    background: #0f0f1a;
  }

  .trial-card-title {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--gold);
  }

  .trial-card-desc {
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.45;
    color: #e6e3f2;
  }

  .trial-card-foot {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding-top: 8px;
    margin-top: 2px;
    border-top: 1px solid #1e1d30;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
  }

  .action-btn {
    background: #241f38;
    color: #ffe08a;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--gold);
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-family: 'Silkscreen', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 6px 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.12s, transform 0.05s;
  }

  .action-btn:hover {
    background: var(--gold);
    color: #141008;
  }

  .action-btn:active {
    transform: translateY(1px);
  }

  .action-btn.primary {
    background: var(--gold);
    color: #141008;
    border-color: #ffe7a3;
  }

  .action-btn.primary:hover {
    background: #ffca4d;
  }

  .action-btn.danger {
    background: #2b131b;
    color: #ff99a8;
    border-color: var(--red-bad);
  }

  .action-btn.danger:hover {
    background: var(--red-bad);
    color: #14080a;
  }

  .ending-switcher {
    display: flex;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 4px;
  }

  /* Modal Overlay */
  .modal-backdrop {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background: rgba(5, 5, 10, 0.84);
    display: none;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    z-index: 40;
    padding: 16px;
  }

  .modal-backdrop.open {
    display: flex;
  }

  .modal-card {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 380px;
    background: #11111e;
    border: 2px solid var(--gold);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 16px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
  }

  .modal-title {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--gold);
    text-align: center;
    padding-bottom: 8px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-dim);
  }

  .modal-desc {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    color: #e4e1f0;
  }

  .code-hook {
    background: #08080f;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-dim);
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #8cc4ff;
    word-break: break-all;
  }

  .modal-actions {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }

  .setting-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #e0dced;
  }

  /* =======================================================================
     TRIAL 2: 2D MONOCHROME SILHOUETTE HANGMAN OVERLAY
     (Black - Charcoal - White ONLY, zero neon, zero emoji, zero ads)
     ======================================================================= */
  .hm-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 60;
    display: none;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: #141517;
    font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
  }

  .hm-overlay.open {
    display: flex;
  }

  .hm-stage {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 480px;
    height: 100vh;
    max-height: 860px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #4b4d52 0%, #7d8086 42%, #b7b9be 78%, #d1d3d7 100%);
    color: #161719;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  /* Atmospheric 2D Silhouette Backdrop SVG */
  .hm-backdrop {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
  }

  @keyframes hmMistDrift {
    0% { transform: translateX(-6%); }
    50% { transform: translateX(6%); }
    100% { transform: translateX(-6%); }
  }

  @keyframes hmCrowFly {
    0% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); opacity: 0.72; }
    50% { transform: translate(42px, -9px); opacity: 0.55; }
    100% { transform: translate(86px, -2px); opacity: 0.72; }
  }

  .hm-mist { animation: hmMistDrift 18s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .hm-crows { animation: hmCrowFly 24s linear infinite alternate; }

  /* Fixed Top Controls (Audio Toggle top-right, Back to Hub top-left) */
  .hm-top-controls {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 10;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 14px 16px 6px;
  }

  .hm-icon-btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    background: rgba(24, 25, 28, 0.82);
    color: #f4f4f5;
    border: 2px solid #f4f4f5;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 6px 11px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s, transform 0.08s;
  }

  .hm-icon-btn:hover {
    background: #101113;
  }

  .hm-icon-btn:active {
    transform: scale(0.97);
  }

  .hm-icon-btn.muted {
    background: rgba(70, 72, 77, 0.78);
    color: #d4d6da;
    border-color: #d4d6da;
  }

  /* Views inside Hangman Stage */
  .hm-view {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 5;
    flex: 1;
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 8px 18px 24px;
    overflow-y: auto;
  }

  .hm-view.active {
    display: flex;
  }

  /* --- 1. HANGMAN HOME SCREEN (Matches 1000032027.jpg!) --- */
  .hm-home-center {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 18px;
    padding-bottom: 58px;
  }

  .hm-logo-svg {
    width: 240px;
    height: auto;
    overflow: visible;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28));
  }

  .hm-pill-btn {
    width: 248px;
    max-width: 82%;
    height: 76px;
    border-radius: 40px;
    background: rgba(128, 130, 136, 0.72);
    border: 3px solid #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22), inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
    color: #1c1d20;
    font-size: 27px;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: 0.8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-shadow:
      -1.5px -1.5px 0 #ffffff,
       1.5px -1.5px 0 #ffffff,
      -1.5px  1.5px 0 #ffffff,
       1.5px  1.5px 0 #ffffff,
       0px    2px   0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
    transition: transform 0.1s, background 0.15s;
  }

  .hm-pill-btn:hover {
    background: rgba(96, 98, 104, 0.86);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }

  .hm-pill-btn:active {
    transform: translateY(1px);
  }

  /* --- 2. SETUP SCREEN (4 LEVELS + 12 TOPICS) --- */
  .hm-section-title {
    margin: 4px 0 8px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: 0.8px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #141517;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
  }

  .hm-diff-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }

  .hm-diff-btn {
    background: rgba(242, 243, 245, 0.82);
    color: #191a1d;
    border: 2px solid #2b2d31;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 9px 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 800;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-align: center;
    transition: all 0.12s;
  }

  .hm-diff-btn.active {
    background: #18191c;
    color: #ffffff;
    border-color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  }

  .hm-topic-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 8px;
    padding-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .hm-topic-btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 9px;
    background: rgba(244, 245, 247, 0.84);
    color: #18191c;
    border: 2px solid #2b2d31;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 9px 10px;
    font-size: 11.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-align: left;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.12s;
  }

  .hm-topic-btn:hover {
    background: #1a1b1f;
    color: #ffffff;
    border-color: #ffffff;
  }

  .hm-topic-btn svg {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    stroke: currentColor;
    fill: none;
    stroke-width: 1.9;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
  }

  /* --- 3. PLAY SCREEN --- */
  
  .hm-hearts-row {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 3px;
  }
  .hm-heart-svg {
    width: 15px;
    height: 15px;
  }

  .hm-play-meta {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    background: rgba(22, 23, 26, 0.84);
    color: #f4f4f5;
    border: 1.5px solid #e6e7ea;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 7px 12px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .hm-gallows-box {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(245, 246, 248, 0.78);
    border: 2px solid #222428;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    min-height: 164px;
  }

  .hm-gallows-svg {
    width: 170px;
    height: 148px;
  }

  .hm-word-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 7px;
    margin: 4px 0 10px;
  }

  .hm-slot {
    width: 28px;
    height: 34px;
    border-bottom: 3px solid #16171a;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 900;
    color: #141518;
  }

  .hm-slot.missed {
    color: #55575e;
    text-decoration: underline;
  }

  .hm-hint-panel {
    background: rgba(24, 25, 28, 0.86);
    color: #f2f3f5;
    border: 1.5px solid #dcdfe4;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 8px 11px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 10px;
    font-size: 11.5px;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  .hm-hint-btn {
    background: #ffffff;
    color: #141518;
    border: 2px solid #141518;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 6px 10px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 800;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .hm-hint-btn:disabled {
    opacity: 0.45;
    cursor: default;
  }

  .hm-kb {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
    gap: 5px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  .hm-key {
    height: 36px;
    background: rgba(246, 247, 249, 0.9);
    color: #16171a;
    border: 2px solid #24262b;
    border-radius: 7px;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 800;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.08s;
  }

  .hm-key:hover:not(:disabled) {
    background: #18191c;
    color: #ffffff;
  }

  .hm-key.hit {
    background: #18191c;
    color: #ffffff;
    border-color: #ffffff;
  }

  .hm-key.miss {
    background: rgba(110, 113, 120, 0.45);
    color: #555860;
    border-color: #6b6e75;
    text-decoration: line-through;
    cursor: default;
  }

  
  .hm-vocab-card {
    background: #111215;
    border: 1.5px solid #e4e6eb;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 9px 11px;
    text-align: left;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
    font-size: 11.5px;
    line-height: 1.45;
    color: #eceef2;
  }
  .hm-vocab-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 8px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #383b42;
    padding-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .hm-vocab-word {
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: 0.8px;
    color: #ffffff;
  }
  .hm-vocab-ipa {
    font-size: 11.5px;
    color: #c5c8d0;
    font-style: italic;
  }
  .hm-vocab-row strong {
    color: #ffffff;
  }
  .hm-vocab-ex {
    color: #d3d6de;
    font-style: italic;
  }

  .hm-result-banner {
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
    background: rgba(18, 19, 22, 0.94);
    color: #ffffff;
    border: 2px solid #ffffff;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 12px;
    text-align: center;
    margin-top: 4px;
  }

  .hm-result-banner.show {
    display: flex;
  }

  .hm-result-actions {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .hm-btn-mono {
    background: #ffffff;
    color: #141518;
    border: 2px solid #141518;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 7px 12px;
    font-size: 11.5px;
    font-weight: 800;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .hm-btn-mono.dark {
    background: #1e2024;
    color: #ffffff;
    border-color: #ffffff;
  }

  /* --- 4. REVIEW SCREEN --- */
  .hm-review-tabs {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  .hm-review-card {
    background: rgba(246, 247, 249, 0.9);
    border: 2px solid #24262b;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    color: #16171a;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }


  /* =======================================================================
     TRIAL 1: WORDLE UI SHELL OVERLAY (Screen 1: Retro CRT + Screen 2: Pixel Board)
     (Visual shell ready for Teammate 1's Wordle logic)
     ======================================================================= */
  .wd-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 65;
    display: none;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: #141322;
    font-family: 'Press Start 2P', 'Silkscreen', monospace;
  }

  .wd-overlay.open {
    display: flex;
  }

  .wd-stage {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 480px;
    height: 100vh;
    max-height: 780px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .wd-screen {
    display: none;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .wd-screen.active {
    display: flex;
  }

  /* --- SCREEN 1: RETRO ARCADE CRT START (Matches 1000032095.jpg) --- */
  .wd-crt-bg {
    background:
      linear-gradient(135deg, #4b4f78 0%, #3a3e63 50%, #4b4f78 100%);
    padding: 26px 20px;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    position: relative;
  }

  .wd-crt-bezel {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 430px;
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
    min-height: 310px;
    background: #2c183b;
    border-radius: 38px;
    border: 5px solid #1d1029;
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 0 42px rgba(10, 4, 18, 0.78),
      0 14px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 20px 24px 24px;
  }

  /* Subtle purple CRT pixel grid */
  .wd-crt-bezel::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(to right, rgba(168, 128, 214, 0.08) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(168, 128, 214, 0.08) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: 38px 38px;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* Glossy curved glass glare */
  .wd-crt-bezel::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 12px;
    left: 22px;
    width: 42%;
    height: 22%;
    border-top: 3px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
    border-left: 3px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: 26px 0 0 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .wd-crt-top {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .wd-hiscore-lbl {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #f7ebbf;
    letter-spacing: 0.6px;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
  }

  .wd-hiscore-val {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #ffa619;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
  }

  .wd-gold-hearts {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .wd-gold-heart {
    width: 18px;
    height: 16px;
    image-rendering: pixelated;
  }

  .wd-crt-center {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    text-align: center;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 18px;
    margin: auto 0;
  }

  .wd-start-logo {
    font-size: 38px;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffdf40 0%, #ffa214 55%, #e86a0c 100%);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 0 #1c0c29);
    line-height: 1.1;
  }

  .wd-ready-q {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #f5ebc4;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
  }

  .wd-choice-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 36px;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  .wd-choice-btn {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    font-family: 'Press Start 2P', 'Silkscreen', monospace;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #f7ebbf;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
    transition: transform 0.08s, color 0.1s;
  }

  .wd-choice-btn:hover,
  .wd-choice-btn.active {
    color: #ffffff;
    transform: scale(1.06);
  }

  .wd-choice-arrow {
    color: #ffa214;
    font-size: 14px;
    visibility: hidden;
  }

  .wd-choice-btn.active .wd-choice-arrow,
  .wd-choice-btn:hover .wd-choice-arrow {
    visibility: visible;
  }

  .wd-crt-back {
    position: absolute;
    top: 10px;
    left: 12px;
    z-index: 5;
    background: rgba(20, 14, 34, 0.8);
    color: #e6e2f5;
    border: 2px solid #8a8fb8;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-family: 'Silkscreen', monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
    padding: 5px 9px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  /* --- SCREEN 2: DARK MYSTICAL CASTLE WORDLE BOARD (Matches 1000032101.jpg) --- */
  .wd-board-screen {
    background-color: #121a16;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(14, 22, 18, 0.42) 0%, rgba(16, 26, 22, 0.24) 55%, rgba(10, 15, 13, 0.72) 100%),
      url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center top;
    image-rendering: pixelated;
    color: #d9efe6;
    position: relative;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  .wd-board-top {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 4;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 10px 12px 2px;
  }

  .wd-top-icon {
    background: rgba(16, 25, 21, 0.72);
    border: 1.5px solid #4e7d6c;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: #d9efe6;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 5px 7px;
  }

  .wd-top-icon:hover {
    color: #7ef5e2;
    border-color: #7ef5e2;
  }

  .wd-cloud-title {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
  }

  .wd-wordle-name {
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #e6f7f0;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    text-shadow: 0 2px 0 #0e1612, 0 0 10px rgba(96, 196, 168, 0.45);
  }

  .wd-cloud-line {
    width: 126px;
    height: 10px;
    opacity: 0.75;
  }

  .wd-streak-row {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 4;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 3px 46px 6px;
    font-size: 9px;
    color: #b7d9cb;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 2px #090e0c;
  }

  .wd-sky-stage {
    position: relative;
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    padding-top: 2px;
  }

  .wd-level-tag {
    position: absolute;
    right: 10px;
    top: 20px;
    z-index: 3;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 8px;
    color: #b7d9cb;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 2px #090e0c;
  }

  .wd-grid {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 4;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 42px);
    gap: 6px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .wd-tile {
    width: 42px;
    height: 42px;
    background: rgba(15, 24, 21, 0.84);
    border: 3px solid #486b5e;
    box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 rgba(8, 13, 11, 0.9), 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
    color: #f0faf6;
    font-size: 18px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .wd-tile.active-cell {
    border-color: #7ef5e2;
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(126, 245, 226, 0.45);
  }

  .wd-tile.st-green {
    background: #1f8a4c;
    border-color: #4cd97b;
    box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 #13542e;
  }

  .wd-tile.st-yellow {
    background: #b58d19;
    border-color: #f2cc4b;
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 #7a5c0c;
  }

  .wd-shell-note {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 4;
    background: rgba(13, 21, 18, 0.86);
    border: 1.5px solid #4d7868;
    color: #cbe6db;
    font-family: 'Silkscreen', monospace;
    font-size: 9px;
    padding: 4px 9px;
    margin-top: auto;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  /* Dark Mossy Cavern & Glowing Teal Waterfall Keyboard Dock */
  .wd-earth-dock {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 5;
    background:
      linear-gradient(180deg, #2b4d3f 0%, #2b4d3f 7px, #1a3027 7px, #1a3027 11px, #161f1c 11px, #0e1412 100%);
    padding: 18px 8px 14px 28px;
    border-top: 2px solid #4e7d6c;
  }

  /* Glowing Bioluminescent Teal Waterfall on Left Edge */
  .wd-waterfall {
    position: absolute;
    left: 6px;
    top: 11px;
    bottom: 12px;
    width: 14px;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      #2a8f7e 0px, #2a8f7e 8px,
      #63dec8 8px, #63dec8 14px
    );
    border-left: 2px solid #0e1714;
    border-right: 2px solid #0e1714;
  }

  .wd-waterpool {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 110px;
    height: 12px;
    background: #1f6e62;
    border-top: 3px solid #63dec8;
  }

  .wd-kb-rows {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 5px;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .wd-kb-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .wd-key {
    min-width: 28px;
    flex: 1;
    max-width: 38px;
    height: 34px;
    background: #55585e;
    border: 2px solid #35373b;
    box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 0 #70747c, inset -2px -2px 0 #383a3e;
    color: #ffffff;
    font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 0;
  }

  .wd-key:hover {
    background: #696d75;
  }

  .wd-key:active {
    transform: translateY(1px);
  }

  .wd-key.wide {
    flex: 1.5;
    max-width: 54px;
    font-size: 9px;
  }

  .wd-board-footer {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 3;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 8px;
  }

  .wd-mini-btn {
    background: #2f3134;
    color: #fff4c2;
    border: 2px solid #ffffff;
    font-family: 'Silkscreen', monospace;
    font-size: 9px;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="app-shell">
  <!-- Top Bar -->
  <header class="top-header">
    <div class="brand-row">
      <div class="brand-title">
        <span class="brand-sq"></span>
        <span>BURN THE BROTHER</span>
      </div>
      <div class="audio-row">
        <button class="pill-btn toggle-on" id="btnBgm">BGM: ON</button>
        <button class="pill-btn toggle-on" id="btnSfx">SFX: ON</button>
        <button class="pill-btn" id="btnLang">EN</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <nav class="nav-pills" id="navPills" aria-label="Story Scenes">
      <button class="pill-btn active" data-scene="TITLE" id="navTitle">1. Title</button>
      <button class="pill-btn" data-scene="HOME" id="navHome">2. Home</button>
      <button class="pill-btn" data-scene="WOODS" id="navWoods">3. Woods</button>
      <button class="pill-btn" data-scene="SORROW" id="navSorrow">4. Sorrow</button>
      <button class="pill-btn" data-scene="LUCIFER" id="navLucifer">5. Lucifer</button>
      <button class="pill-btn" data-scene="PATH" id="navPath">6. Path</button>
      <button class="pill-btn" data-scene="TRIALS" id="navTrials">7. Trials</button>
      <button class="pill-btn" data-scene="ENDING" id="navEnding">8. Ending</button>
    </nav>
  </header>

  <!-- Main Viewport -->
  <main class="stage-frame">
    <canvas id="mainCanvas" width="260" height="316" class="tall-title"></canvas>

    <!-- Story / Ending / Lucifer Dialogue Box -->
    <section class="dialogue-panel hidden" id="dialoguePanel">
      <div>
        <div class="speaker-label" id="speakerLabel"></div>
        <div class="dialogue-text" id="dialogueText"></div>
        <div class="lucifer-choices" id="luciferChoices" style="display:none;"></div>
        <div class="ending-switcher" id="endingActions" style="display:none;"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="dialogue-footer">
        <button class="back-btn" id="btnBack">◄ BACK</button>
        <div class="next-hint" id="btnNextHint">
          <span id="nextHintText">Click or press Space</span>
          <span class="blink-tri">▼</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Scene 7: Trials Hub (Teammate 1 & Teammate 2 Modules) -->
    <section class="trials-view" id="trialsView">
      <div class="trials-topbar">
        <button class="back-btn" id="btnTrialsStory">◄ STORY</button>
        <span style="font-size:10px;color:#9b97b3;" id="lblChooseTrial">CHOOSE YOUR TRIAL</span>
        <button class="back-btn" id="btnTrialsReplay">↻ REPLAY TITLE</button>
      </div>

      <div class="trials-hero">
        <h2 id="lblTrialsHeroTitle">SAVE YOUR BROTHER</h2>
        <p id="lblTrialsHeroDesc">A wicked witch took your brother. Clear both trials to rescue him!</p>
      </div>

      <div class="progress-strip">
        <span id="lblProgress">PROGRESS:</span>
        <span class="badge-pill" id="badgeT1">TRIAL 1: PENDING</span>
        <span class="badge-pill" id="badgeT2">TRIAL 2: PENDING</span>
      </div>

      <!-- Card 1: FRAME 7 — WORDLE (Teammate 1 Module) -->
      <article class="trial-card" id="cardTrial1">
        <div class="trial-card-head">
          <span>FRAME 7</span>
          <span class="trial-tag" id="tagT1">TRIAL 1</span>
        </div>
        <canvas class="trial-preview-canvas" id="previewWordle" width="240" height="190"></canvas>
        <div class="trial-card-body">
          <div class="trial-card-title">CHALLENGE 1: WORDLE</div>
          <div class="trial-card-desc" id="descT1">Train and gain experience to solve words</div>
          <div class="trial-card-foot">
            <span id="modT1">Teammate 1 Module</span>
            <button class="action-btn" id="btnPlayT1">PLAY ▸</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </article>

      <!-- Card 2: FRAME 8 — HANGMAN (Teammate 2 Module) -->
      <article class="trial-card" id="cardTrial2">
        <div class="trial-card-head">
          <span>FRAME 8</span>
          <span class="trial-tag" id="tagT2">TRIAL 2</span>
        </div>
        <canvas class="trial-preview-canvas" id="previewHangman" width="240" height="190"></canvas>
        <div class="trial-card-body">
          <div class="trial-card-title">CHALLENGE 2: HANGMAN</div>
          <div class="trial-card-desc" id="descT2">Rescue before he gets hanged!</div>
          <div class="trial-card-foot">
            <span id="modT2">Teammate 2 Module</span>
            <button class="action-btn" id="btnPlayT2">RESCUE ▸</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </article>

      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:2px;">
        <button class="action-btn primary" id="btnGoGoodEnd" style="display:none;">VIEW ENDING ▸</button>
      </div>
    </section>

    <div class="scanlines" id="scanlinesOverlay"></div>
  </main>
</div>


<!-- =========================================================================
     TRIAL 2: HANGMAN (2D MONOCHROME SILHOUETTE EDITION)
     ========================================================================= -->
<div class="hm-overlay" id="hangmanOverlay" aria-label="Hang Man Game">
  <div class="hm-stage">
    <!-- 2D Dark Silhouette Atmospheric Backdrop (Moon, Crows, Mist, Dark Hill, Bare Tree) -->
    <svg class="hm-backdrop" viewBox="0 0 400 720" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMax slice" aria-hidden="true">
      <defs>
        <radialGradient id="hmMoonGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f2f3f5" stop-opacity="0.72"/>
          <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#dfe1e5" stop-opacity="0.25"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7d8086" stop-opacity="0"/>
        </radialGradient>
        <linearGradient id="hmMistGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e5e7eb" stop-opacity="0"/>
          <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#e5e7eb" stop-opacity="0.26"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e5e7eb" stop-opacity="0"/>
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      <!-- Pale Misty Moon -->
      <circle cx="88" cy="112" r="68" fill="url(#hmMoonGlow)"/>
      <circle cx="88" cy="112" r="24" fill="#eceef0" opacity="0.78"/>
      <!-- Distant Flying Crows Silhouette -->
      <g class="hm-crows" fill="none" stroke="#1f2024" stroke-width="2.1" stroke-linecap="round">
        <path d="M168 128 Q174 121 180 128 Q186 121 192 128"/>
        <path d="M204 146 Q209 140 214 146 Q219 140 224 146"/>
        <path d="M136 154 Q140 149 144 154 Q148 149 152 154"/>
        <path d="M238 118 Q242 114 246 118 Q250 114 254 118"/>
      </g>
      <!-- Drifting Mist Layers -->
      <g class="hm-mist">
        <rect x="-40" y="470" width="480" height="72" fill="url(#hmMistGrad)"/>
        <rect x="-40" y="545" width="480" height="64" fill="url(#hmMistGrad)" opacity="0.8"/>
      </g>
      <!-- Bare Gnarled Silhouette Tree at Bottom-Right (matching 1000032027.jpg) -->
      <g stroke="#1c1d20" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
        <path d="M338 676 Q336 632 332 596" stroke-width="6.5"/>
        <path d="M333 616 Q312 594 294 584" stroke-width="3.6"/>
        <path d="M312 598 Q304 582 292 568" stroke-width="2.2"/>
        <path d="M302 588 Q286 586 274 576" stroke-width="1.8"/>
        <path d="M332 604 Q326 574 316 552" stroke-width="3.2"/>
        <path d="M324 576 Q312 564 302 554" stroke-width="1.9"/>
        <path d="M322 568 Q328 552 330 538" stroke-width="1.8"/>
        <path d="M333 602 Q352 578 368 564" stroke-width="3.4"/>
        <path d="M348 584 Q362 582 378 574" stroke-width="2.1"/>
        <path d="M352 578 Q356 560 364 548" stroke-width="1.8"/>
        <path d="M336 622 Q358 606 376 598" stroke-width="2.8"/>
        <path d="M356 608 Q368 608 382 602" stroke-width="1.6"/>
        <path d="M329 592 Q338 564 344 544" stroke-width="2.4"/>
      </g>
      <!-- Dark Rolling Hill Silhouette at Bottom -->
      <path d="M0 684 Q105 674 205 660 Q310 644 400 664 L400 720 L0 720 Z" fill="#232428"/>
      <path d="M0 700 Q150 688 280 682 Q355 679 400 686 L400 720 L0 720 Z" fill="#141518"/>
    </svg>

    <!-- Top Fixed Controls -->
    <div class="hm-top-controls">

    <!-- VIEW 3: PLAY SCREEN -->

          <line x1="48" y1="145" x2="48" y2="16" stroke-width="4.5"/>

          <line id="hmPart2" x1="124" y1="62" x2="124" y2="102" stroke-width="3.2" style="display:none;"/>

<script>
(() => {
  'use strict';

  // =========================================================================
  // TEAMMATE INTEGRATION BRIDGE
  // Plug your two teammates' Wordle & Hangman modules here:
  //   window.GameBridge.onLaunchTrial1 = () => { /* open Wordle */ };
  //   window.GameBridge.onLaunchTrial2 = () => { /* open Hangman */ };
  //   window.GameBridge.completeTrial(1, true); // or (2, true/false)
  // =========================================================================
  window.GameBridge = {
    onLaunchTrial1: null,
    onLaunchTrial2: null,
    completeTrial: (trialNum, won) => handleTrialResult(trialNum, won),
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // 1. CANVAS & PIXEL-ART DRAWING ENGINE
  // =========================================================================
  const mainCanvas = document.getElementById('mainCanvas');
  const ctx = mainCanvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

  const titleArtImg = new Image();
  let titleArtReady = false;
  titleArtImg.onload = () => { titleArtReady = true; };
  titleArtImg.src = "data:image/png;base64,";


  const pWordleCanvas = document.getElementById('previewWordle');
  const pWordleCtx = pWordleCanvas.getContext('2d');
  pWordleCtx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

  const pHangmanCanvas = document.getElementById('previewHangman');
  const pHangmanCtx = pHangmanCanvas.getContext('2d');
  pHangmanCtx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

  const px = (c, x, y, w, h, color) => {
    c.fillStyle = color;
    c.fillRect(Math.floor(x), Math.floor(y), Math.floor(w), Math.floor(h));
  };

  const ditherRect = (c, x, y, w, h, c1, c2, density = 0.5) => {
    const x0 = Math.floor(x), y0 = Math.floor(y);
    const x1 = x0 + Math.floor(w), y1 = y0 + Math.floor(h);
    for (let j = y0; j < y1; j++) {
      for (let i = x0; i < x1; i++) {
        let use2 = false;
        if (density >= 0.75) use2 = !((i % 2 === 0) && (j % 2 === 0));
        else if (density >= 0.5) use2 = ((i + j) % 2 === 0);
        else use2 = ((i % 2 === 0) && (j % 2 === 0));
        c.fillStyle = use2 ? c2 : c1;
        c.fillRect(i, j, 1, 1);
      }
    }
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // 2. UNIFIED CUTE CHIBI CHARACTER PALETTES & PIXEL SPRITES
  // =========================================================================
  const PAL = {
    color: {
      K: '#0c0a12', // crisp 1px dark outline
      W: '#ffffff', // pure white hair / cat / eye catchlight / collar
      w: '#d5ddf0', // soft lavender-blue hair/fur shadow
      S: '#fde0cc', // soft peach skin (sister)
      s: '#e6bfa6', // skin shade
      B: '#f598a8', // adorable rosy blush cheeks
      D: '#171624', // black dress
      d: '#302e47', // dress soft highlight
      E: '#1a1426', // big shiny chibi eyes
      H: '#6e3c1f', // brother chestnut hair
      h: '#47220d', // hair dark shade
      l: '#9c5c34', // warm hair highlight
      P: '#f7cba8', // brother skin
      p: '#d6a17a', // brother skin shade
      T: '#b84b2e', // terracotta shirt
      t: '#82311b', // shirt shade
      G: '#4d4e5c', // charcoal shorts
      g: '#30313b', // shorts shade
      V: '#754899', // witch purple
      v: '#4a2a63', // witch purple dark
      u: '#9f6fc7', // witch purple highlight
      A: '#a7adb8', // witch gray hair
      a: '#6d7380', // witch gray hair shade
      F: '#e6bcbd', // witch pale face
      f: '#bd9093', // witch face shade
      C: '#5ec8f2', // iconic cyan-blue tears
      M: '#e06372', // cute pink open mouth
      R: '#945e34', // firewood
      r: '#5e371a', // firewood dark
      Y: '#f5c23b', // gold
    },
    mono: {
      K: '#0a0a10',
      W: '#f7f8fc', w: '#bfc6d4',
      S: '#d8dce6', s: '#a4aab8',
      B: '#b5bac7',
      D: '#11111a', d: '#2d2f3d',
      E: '#0f0f17',
      H: '#3a3a45', h: '#1f1f26', l: '#60606e',
      P: '#d8dce6', p: '#a4aab8',
      T: '#545461', t: '#33333d',
      G: '#383842', g: '#1f1f26',
      V: '#4e4e5c', v: '#2b2b33', u: '#7c7c8a',
      A: '#b8bdc7', a: '#7b808c',
      F: '#d2d7e0', f: '#989ea8',
      C: '#5ec8f2', // keeps iconic cyan-blue tears!
      M: '#4a4a54',
      R: '#686873', r: '#3d3d45',
      Y: '#dcdce3',
    },
    bw: {
      K: '#000000',
      W: '#ffffff', w: '#d6d6d6',
      S: '#ffffff', s: '#cccccc',
      B: '#a6a6a6',
      D: '#08080c', d: '#363636',
      E: '#000000',
      H: '#161616', h: '#000000', l: '#4f4f4f',
      P: '#ffffff', p: '#cccccc',
      T: '#6b6b6b', t: '#333333',
      G: '#242424', g: '#000000',
      V: '#161616', v: '#000000', u: '#595959',
      A: '#d1d1d1', a: '#7a7a7a',
      F: '#ffffff', f: '#bdbdbd',
      C: '#ffffff',
      M: '#000000',
      R: '#8a8a8a', r: '#444444',
      Y: '#ffffff',
    }
  };

  function drawSprite(targetCtx, grid, x, y, scale = 1, paletteName = 'color', flipX = false, rimColor = null) {
    const pal = PAL[paletteName] || PAL.color;
    const rows = grid.length;
    const cols = grid[0].length;
    if (rimColor) {
      targetCtx.fillStyle = rimColor;
      for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        const row = grid[r];
        for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
          const ch = row[c];
          if (ch === '.' || ch === ' ') continue;
          const dx = flipX ? (cols - 1 - c) : c;
          const px0 = Math.floor(x + dx * scale);
          const py0 = Math.floor(y + r * scale);
          targetCtx.fillRect(px0 - 1, py0, scale + 2, scale);
          targetCtx.fillRect(px0, py0 - 1, scale, scale + 2);
        }
      }
    }
    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
      const row = grid[r];
      for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
        const ch = row[c];
        if (ch === '.' || ch === ' ') continue;
        const col = pal[ch];
        if (!col) continue;
        const dx = flipX ? (cols - 1 - c) : c;
        targetCtx.fillStyle = col;
        targetCtx.fillRect(Math.floor(x + dx * scale), Math.floor(y + r * scale), scale, scale);
      }
    }
  }

  function drawDitheredSprite(targetCtx, grid, x, y, scale = 1) {
    for (let r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
      for (let c = 0; c < grid[0].length; c++) {
        const ch = grid[r][c];
        if (ch === '.') continue;
        let col = '#000000';
        if (ch === 'W') col = ((r + c) % 2 === 0) ? '#e2e2e2' : '#707070';
        else if (ch === 'w') col = ((r + c) % 2 === 0) ? '#9e9e9e' : '#404040';
        targetCtx.fillStyle = col;
        targetCtx.fillRect(Math.floor(x + c * scale), Math.floor(y + r * scale), scale, scale);
      }
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // REDESIGNED SUPER-CUTE CHIBI SPRITES (FULL FLUFFY BANGS, BIG SHINY EYES!)
  // =========================================================================

  // --- LITTLE SISTER: CUTE SAD STANDING (22x24) ---
  // Fluffy full white bangs curving softly over forehead, clean face,
  // big 2x2 sparkling chibi eyes, rosy cheeks, tiny cute frown!
  const SPR_SISTER_SAD = [
    '......KKKKKKKKKK......',
    '....KKWWWWWWWWWWKK....',
    '...KWWWWWWWWWWWWWWK...',
    '..KWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWK..',
    '..KWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWK..',
    '.KWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWK.',
    '.KWWWWWWKWWWWKWWWWWWK.',
    '.KWWWWWKSSWWSSKWWWWWK.',
    '.KWWWWKSSSSSSSSKWWWWK.',
    '.KWWWKSWESSSSWESKWWWK.',
    '.KWWWKSEESSSSEESKWWWK.',
    '.KWWWKBBSSKKSSBBKWWWK.',
    '.KWWWwKSSSSSSSSKwWWWK.',
    '.KWWWWwwKSSSSKwwWWWWK.',
    'KKWWWWwKKWWWWKKwWWWWK.',
    'KWWWWWKKDDDDDDKKWWWWK.',
    '.KKKKKKDDDDDDDDKKKKK..',
    '.....KDDdDDDDdDDK.....',
    '....KSDDDDDDDDDDSK....',
    '....KKDDDDDDDDDDKK....',
    '.....KDDDDDDDDDDK.....',
    '.....KKSSKKKKSSKK.....',
    '......KDDK..KDDK......',
    '......KKKK..KKKK......',
  ];

  // --- LITTLE SISTER: CUTE HAPPY RUNNING (22x24) ---
  const SPR_SISTER_HAPPY = [
    '......KKKKKKKKKK......',
    '....KKWWWWWWWWWWKK....',
    '...KWWWWWWWWWWWWWWK...',
    '..KWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWK..',
    '..KWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWK..',
    '.KWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWK.',
    '.KWWWWWWKWWWWKWWWWWWK.',
    '.KWWWWWKSSWWSSKWWWWWK.',
    '.KWWWWKSSSSSSSSKWWWWK.',
    '.KWWWKSSEESSSSEESKWWK.',
    '.KWWWKBBSSSSSSBBKWWWK.',
    'K.KWWwKSSKMMKSSKwWWK.K',
    'KSKWWwwKKWWWWKKwwWWKSK',
    'KDDKKwwKDDDDDDKwwKKDDK',
    '.KKDDKKDDDDDDDDKKDDKK.',
    '...KKDDDDDDDDDDDDKK...',
    '.....KDDdDDDDdDDK.....',
    '.....KDDDDDDDDDDK.....',
    '....KDDDDDDDDDDDDK....',
    '....KKKSSKKKKSSKKK....',
    '......KDDK...KDDK.....',
    '......KKKK...KKKK.....',
    '......................',
    '......................',
  ];

  // --- LITTLE SISTER: CUTE KNEELING CRYING (22x22) ---
  const SPR_SISTER_CRY = [
    '......KKKKKKKKKK......',
    '....KKWWWWWWWWWWKK....',
    '...KWWWWWWWWWWWWWWK...',
    '..KWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWK..',
    '..KWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWK..',
    '.KWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWK.',
    '.KWWWWWWKWWWWKWWWWWWK.',
    '.KWWWWWKSSWWSSKWWWWWK.',
    '.KWWWWKSSSSSSSSKWWWWK.',
    '.KWWWKSSKKSSKKSSKWWWK.',
    '.KWWWKSCSSSSSSCSKWWWK.',
    '.KWWWKSCsSKKSsCSKWWWK.',
    'KKWWWwKSCSSSSCSKwWWWK.',
    'KWWWWwwKKWWWWKKwwWWWK.',
    'KWWWWwKDDSSSSDDKwWWK..',
    '.KKKKKDDDSSSSDDDKWK...',
    '.....KDDdDKKDdDDK.....',
    '.....KDDDDDDDDDDK.....',
    '....KDDDDDDDDDDDDK....',
    '....KKKWWWKKKKWWWKK...',
    '......KKKKK..KKKKK....',
    '......................',
  ];

  // --- LITTLE SISTER: CUTE PORTRAIT WITH QUILL (20x18) ---
  const SPR_SISTER_PORTRAIT = [
    '....KKKKKKKKKK......',
    '..KKWWWWWWWWWWKK....',

  // =========================================================================
  // 3. 8-BIT CHIPTUNE AUDIO ENGINE
  // =========================================================================
  const Audio8Bit = (() => {
    let ac = null;
    let bgmOn = true;
    let sfxOn = true;
    let timer = null;
    let mood = null;
    let step = 0;

    const init = () => {
      if (!ac) {
        const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
        if (AC) ac = new AC();
      }
      if (ac && ac.state === 'suspended') ac.resume().catch(() => {});
    };

    const tone = (freq, dur, type = 'square', vol = 0.05, delay = 0, isBgm = false) => {
      if (isBgm && !bgmOn) return;
      if (!isBgm && !sfxOn) return;
      init();
      if (!ac || !freq) return;
      const now = ac.currentTime + delay;
      const osc = ac.createOscillator();
      const gain = ac.createGain();
      osc.type = type;
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, now);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0008, now + dur);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ac.destination);
      osc.start(now);
      osc.stop(now + dur + 0.02);
    };

    const sfx = {
      click: () => tone(540, 0.045, 'square', 0.045),
      blip: () => tone(360 + Math.random() * 80, 0.028, 'square', 0.022),
      confirm: () => { tone(440, 0.06, 'square', 0.05, 0); tone(660, 0.1, 'square', 0.05, 0.06); },
      danger: () => { tone(240, 0.12, 'sawtooth', 0.065, 0); tone(185, 0.16, 'sawtooth', 0.065, 0.1); tone(138, 0.24, 'sawtooth', 0.06, 0.22); },
      fire: () => { tone(196, 0.14, 'sawtooth', 0.06, 0); tone(261, 0.12, 'square', 0.05, 0.08); tone(330, 0.18, 'sawtooth', 0.055, 0.16); },
      eerie: () => { tone(220, 0.15, 'triangle', 0.07, 0); tone(207, 0.25, 'sawtooth', 0.05, 0.14); },
      win: () => { [523, 659, 784, 1046, 784, 1046].forEach((f, i) => tone(f, 0.13, 'square', 0.055, i * 0.095)); },
      lose: () => { [311, 293, 261, 220, 174].forEach((f, i) => tone(f, 0.17, 'sawtooth', 0.055, i * 0.13)); },
      // Good Ending (BURN THE WITCH!): embedded real witch scream clip at balanced volume (0.45)
      witchScream: () => {
        if (!sfxOn) return;
        try {
          if (!window._witchScreamAudio) {
            window._witchScreamAudio = new Audio("data:audio/mpeg;base64,");
          }
          const a = window._witchScreamAudio;
          a.pause();
          a.currentTime = 0;
          a.volume = 0.45;
          a.play().catch(() => {});
        } catch (e) {}
      },
      // Bad Ending (BURN THE BROTHER): plays the 4s witch cackle twice (~8s total)
      witchLaugh: (repeats = 2) => {
        if (!sfxOn) return;
        try {
          if (!window._witchLaughAudio) {
            window._witchLaughAudio = new Audio("data:audio/mpeg;base64,");
          }
          const a = window._witchLaughAudio;
          a.pause();
          a.currentTime = 0;
          a.volume = 0.42;
          let remaining = Math.max(1, repeats) - 1;
          a.onended = () => {
            if (remaining > 0 && sfxOn && state.scene === 'ENDING' && state.endingType === 'bad' && state.subBeat === 0) {
              remaining--;
              a.currentTime = 0;
              a.play().catch(() => {});
            } else {
              a.onended = null;
            }
          };
          a.play().catch(() => {});
        } catch (e) {}
      },
      // Bad Ending (BURN THE BROTHER): embedded user scream clip at softer balanced volume (0.35)
      brotherScream: () => {
        if (!sfxOn) return;
        try {
          if (!window._brotherScreamAudio) {
            window._brotherScreamAudio = new Audio("data:audio/mpeg;base64,");
          }
          const a = window._brotherScreamAudio;
          a.pause();
          a.currentTime = 0;
          a.volume = 0.35;
          a.play().catch(() => {});
        } catch (e) {}
      },
      stopBrotherScream: () => {
        if (window._witchLaughTimer) { clearTimeout(window._witchLaughTimer); window._witchLaughTimer = null; }
        try {
          if (window._brotherScreamAudio) {
            window._brotherScreamAudio.pause();
            window._brotherScreamAudio.currentTime = 0;
          }
          if (window._witchLaughAudio) {
            window._witchLaughAudio.onended = null;
            window._witchLaughAudio.pause();
            window._witchLaughAudio.currentTime = 0;
          }
          if (window._witchScreamAudio) {
            window._witchScreamAudio.pause();
            window._witchScreamAudio.currentTime = 0;
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      }
    };

    const MOODS = {
      title:  { tempo: 300, notes: [220, 0, 261.63, 246.94, 220, 0, 196, 164.81] },
      // Extra bright, joyful, bouncy 8-bit major melody for Home & Good Reunion!
      home: {
        tempo: 175,
        special: 'bright',
        notes: [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5, 880, 783.99, 659.25, 783.99, 698.46, 880, 1046.5, 880, 783.99, 659.25, 587.33, 783.99],
        bass:  [261.63, 0, 196, 0, 220, 0, 196, 0, 174.61, 0, 220, 0, 196, 0, 196, 0],
      },
      // Snow White style Beat 1: gentle pastoral fairytale woodland flute/harp while brother gathers firewood
      woodsCalm: {

        special: 'pastoral',
        notes: [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 659.25, 587.33, 698.46, 880, 698.46, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5, 783.99, 587.33, 659.25, 523.25, 0],
        bass:  [261.63, 0, 329.63, 0, 293.66, 0, 349.23, 0, 261.63, 0, 329.63, 0, 196, 0, 261.63, 0],
      },
      // Snow White Huntsman ambush Beat 2: sudden dramatic dark operatic soprano + trembling strings & timpani!
      woodsOpera: {
        tempo: 185,
        special: 'opera',
        notes: [659.25, 698.46, 659.25, 622.25, 659.25, 783.99, 880, 830.61, 783.99, 698.46, 659.25, 587.33, 523.25, 493.88, 440, 0],
        bass:  [110, 110, 116.54, 110, 130.81, 130.81, 123.47, 116.54, 110, 110, 103.83, 98, 92.5, 87.31, 82.41, 82.41],
      },
      // Melancholy 3/4 waltz music-box inspired by "Old Doll" (Sorrow & Bad Ending Sister Crying)
      oldDoll: {
        tempo: 330,
        special: 'oldDoll',
        notes: [659.25, 523.25, 493.88, 440, 0, 523.25, 587.33, 523.25, 493.88, 440, 392, 0, 659.25, 698.46, 659.25, 587.33, 523.25, 493.88, 440, 329.63, 440, 0, 0, 0],
        bass:  [110, 220, 261.63, 110, 220, 261.63, 146.83, 220, 293.66, 130.81, 196, 261.63, 110, 220, 261.63, 123.47, 196, 246.94, 110, 164.81, 220, 110, 0, 0],
      },
      // Haunting lo-fi detuned music-box & hollow drone inspired by "The Lobotomy" (Lucifer & Path)
      lobotomy: {
        tempo: 420,
        special: 'lobotomy',
        notes: [440, 523.25, 493.88, 392, 440, 349.23, 329.63, 0, 440, 523.25, 587.33, 523.25, 493.88, 392, 329.63, 0],
        bass:  [110, 0, 0, 0, 87.31, 0, 0, 0, 130.81, 0, 0, 0, 98.00, 0, 0, 0],
      },
      trials: { tempo: 260, notes: [293.66, 349.23, 440, 392, 349.23, 329.63, 293.66, 261.63] },
      // FNAF Puppet's Music Box ("My Grandfather's Clock" haunting crystalline music-box) for BURN THE WITCH!
      puppetBox: {
        tempo: 250,
        special: 'puppetBox',
        notes: [
          392.00, 523.25, 493.88, 523.25, 587.33, 523.25, 587.33, 659.25,
          698.46, 659.25, 440.00, 587.33, 523.25, 0, 523.25, 493.88,
          440.00, 493.88, 523.25, 0, 392.00, 523.25, 493.88, 523.25,
          587.33, 523.25, 587.33, 659.25, 698.46, 659.25, 440.00, 587.33,
          523.25, 493.88, 523.25, 0
        ],
        bass: [
          0, 261.63, 0, 261.63, 246.94, 0, 196.00, 0,
          174.61, 0, 220.00, 0, 261.63, 0, 0, 0,
          174.61, 196.00, 261.63, 0, 0, 261.63, 0, 261.63,
          246.94, 0, 196.00, 0, 174.61, 0, 220.00, 0,
          261.63, 196.00, 261.63, 0
        ],
      },
      endingGood: {
        tempo: 170,
        special: 'bright',
        notes: [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5, 987.77, 1046.5, 1174.66, 1046.5, 880, 1046.5, 880, 783.99, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5, 0],
        bass:  [261.63, 0, 196, 0, 261.63, 0, 196, 0, 174.61, 0, 220, 0, 196, 0, 261.63, 0],
      },
      // Dark lo-fi ambient / haunting distorted drone inspired by "SIGNS" (SylviaPark) for BURN THE BROTHER
      burnBrother: {
        tempo: 480,
        special: 'signs',
        notes: [277.18, 0, 246.94, 220.00, 0, 207.65, 185.00, 0, 277.18, 0, 311.13, 277.18, 246.94, 0, 185.00, 0],
        bass:  [92.50, 0, 0, 0, 77.78, 0, 0, 0, 82.41, 0, 0, 0, 69.30, 0, 0, 0],
      },
    };

    const setMood = (mName) => {
      if (mood === mName) return;
      mood = mName;
      if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; }
      const m = MOODS[mName];
      if (!m) return;
      step = 0;
      timer = setInterval(() => {
        if (!bgmOn || !ac || ac.state !== 'running' || (typeof HangmanModule !== 'undefined' && HangmanModule.isOpen())) return;
        const idx = step % m.notes.length;
        const f = m.notes[idx];
        if (m.special === 'bright') {
          // Sparkling upbeat 8-bit square + warm triangle bass (Home & Reunion!)
          if (f) {
            tone(f, 0.14, 'square', 0.048, 0, true);
            tone(f * 2, 0.09, 'sine', 0.022, 0.01, true);
          }
          const bf = m.bass[idx];
          if (bf) tone(bf, 0.24, 'triangle', 0.068, 0, true);
        } else if (m.special === 'oldDoll') {
          // Boosted haunting 3/4 waltz music-box inspired by "Old Doll" (Scene 4 Sorrow & Bad Ending Beat 2)
          if (f) {
            tone(f, 0.75, 'sine', 0.135, 0, true);
            tone(f * 2, 0.38, 'triangle', 0.052, 0.01, true);
          }
          const bf = m.bass[idx];
          if (bf) tone(bf, 0.58, 'triangle', 0.105, 0, true);
        } else if (m.special === 'lobotomy') {
          // Boosted eerie detuned lo-fi music-box bell + hollow pad ("The Lobotomy" — Scene 5 Lucifer, Scene 6 Path, Lucifer Gate & Candle Wraith)
          if (f) {
            const wobble = 1 + Math.sin(step * 0.7) * 0.008;
            tone(f * wobble, 1.02, 'sine', 0.135, 0, true);
            tone(f * wobble * 1.006, 0.82, 'triangle', 0.072, 0.02, true);
          }
          const bf = m.bass[idx];
          if (bf) {
            tone(bf, 1.8, 'triangle', 0.135, 0, true);
            tone(bf * 1.5, 1.65, 'sine', 0.062, 0.04, true);
          }
        } else if (m.special === 'pastoral') {
          // Gentle fairytale woodland flute + soft harp pluck
          if (f) {
            tone(f, 0.34, 'sine', 0.056, 0, true);
            tone(f * 2, 0.16, 'triangle', 0.018, 0.02, true);
          }
          const bf = m.bass[idx];
          if (bf) tone(bf, 0.42, 'triangle', 0.044, 0, true);
        } else if (m.special === 'opera') {
          // Dramatic dark operatic vocal/string tremolo + pounding timpani bass
          if (f) {
            const vib = 1 + Math.sin(step * 1.9) * 0.014;
            tone(f * vib, 0.28, 'sawtooth', 0.046, 0, true);
            tone(f * 0.5 * vib, 0.26, 'triangle', 0.052, 0.01, true);
          }
          const bf = m.bass[idx];
          if (bf) {
            tone(bf, 0.22, 'sawtooth', 0.056, 0, true);
            tone(bf * 0.5, 0.18, 'triangle', 0.068, 0, true);
          }
        } else if (m.special === 'signs') {
          // Haunting lo-fi dark-ambient synth swells + detuned eerie harmonic + deep brooding drone ("SIGNS" vibe)
          if (f) {
            const drift = 1 + Math.sin(step * 0.55) * 0.011;
            tone(f * drift, 1.35, 'sawtooth', 0.036, 0, true);
            tone(f * drift * 0.994, 1.45, 'triangle', 0.052, 0.03, true);
            tone(f * 2 * drift, 0.95, 'sine', 0.022, 0.08, true);
          }
          const bf = m.bass[idx];
          if (bf) {
            tone(bf, 2.2, 'sawtooth', 0.042, 0, true);
            tone(bf * 0.5, 2.3, 'triangle', 0.075, 0, true);
          }
        } else if (m.special === 'puppetBox') {
          // Crystalline FNAF Puppet Music Box bell tones (sharp metallic pluck + delicate high chime)
          if (f) {
            tone(f * 2, 0.52, 'sine', 0.064, 0, true);
            tone(f * 4, 0.22, 'triangle', 0.026, 0.005, true);
            tone(f, 0.45, 'sine', 0.028, 0.01, true);
          }
          const bf = m.bass[idx];
          if (bf) tone(bf * 2, 0.45, 'sine', 0.032, 0, true);
        } else {
          // Louder, fuller 8-bit BGM across all remaining scenes
          if (f) {
            tone(f, (m.tempo / 1000) * 0.78, 'triangle', 0.072, 0, true);
            tone(f * 0.5, (m.tempo / 1000) * 0.65, 'sine', 0.032, 0, true);
          }
        }
        step++;
      }, m.tempo);
    };

    return {
      init, sfx, setMood,
      isBgm: () => bgmOn,
      isSfx: () => sfxOn,
      toggleBgm: () => { bgmOn = !bgmOn; if (bgmOn) init(); return bgmOn; },
      toggleSfx: () => { sfxOn = !sfxOn; if (sfxOn) init(); else sfx.stopBrotherScream(); return sfxOn; },
    };
  })();
