  // =========================================================================
  // 5. STATE & STORY FLOW
  // =========================================================================
  const state = {
    scene: 'TITLE', // TITLE, HOME, WOODS, SORROW, LUCIFER, PATH, TRIALS, ENDING
    subBeat: 0,     // WOODS: 0/1 | ENDING(good): 0=Burn Witch, 1=Reunited | ENDING(bad): 0=Burn Brother, 1=Sister Crying
    endingType: 'good', // 'good' | 'bad'
    lang: 'en',
    crt: false,
    tick: 0,
    sceneTick: 0,
    typeIdx: 0,
    luciferCursor: 0,
    shakeFrames: 0,
    flashFrames: 0,
    trials: { t1: false, t2: false },
    activeModalTrial: 1,
  };

  const t = (k) => TEXT[state.lang][k];

  function getActiveDialogue() {
    if (state.scene === 'HOME') return { speaker: t('homeSpeaker'), text: t('homeText') };
    if (state.scene === 'WOODS') {
      return state.subBeat === 0
        ? { speaker: t('woods1Speaker'), text: t('woods1Text') }
        : { speaker: t('woods2Speaker'), text: t('woods2Text') };
    }
    if (state.scene === 'SORROW') return { speaker: t('sorrowSpeaker'), text: t('sorrowText') };
    if (state.scene === 'LUCIFER') return { speaker: t('luciferSpeaker'), text: '' };
    if (state.scene === 'PATH') return { speaker: t('pathSpeaker'), text: t('pathText') };
    if (state.scene === 'LUCIFER_GATE') {
      return state.subBeat === 0
        ? { speaker: t('lucGateSpeaker'), text: t('lucGateText') }
        : { speaker: t('lucGateSpeaker'), text: t('lucGateNoReply') };
    }
    if (state.scene === 'WRAITH') return { speaker: t('wraithSpeaker'), text: t('wraithText'), cls: 'fire-bad' };
    if (state.scene === 'ENDING') {
      if (state.endingType === 'good') {
        return state.subBeat === 0
          ? { speaker: t('good1Speaker'), text: t('good1Text'), cls: 'fire-good' }
          : { speaker: t('good2Speaker'), text: t('good2Text') };
      } else {
        return state.subBeat === 0
          ? { speaker: t('bad1Speaker'), text: t('bad1Text'), cls: 'fire-bad' }
          : { speaker: t('bad2Speaker'), text: t('bad2Text'), cls: 'fire-bad' };
      }
    }
    return { speaker: '', text: '' };
  }

  function setScene(sceneName, subBeat = 0) {
    Audio8Bit.sfx.stopBrotherScream();
    state.scene = sceneName;
    state.subBeat = subBeat;
    state.typeIdx = 0;
    state.sceneTick = 0;
    state.shakeFrames = ((sceneName === 'WOODS' && subBeat === 1) || (sceneName === 'ENDING' && subBeat === 0)) ? 16 : 0;
    state.flashFrames = (sceneName === 'ENDING' && subBeat === 0) ? 16 : 0;

    if (sceneName === 'TITLE') Audio8Bit.setMood('title');
    else if (sceneName === 'HOME') Audio8Bit.setMood('home');
    else if (sceneName === 'WOODS') Audio8Bit.setMood(subBeat === 0 ? 'woodsCalm' : 'woodsOpera');
    else if (sceneName === 'SORROW') Audio8Bit.setMood('oldDoll');
    else if (sceneName === 'LUCIFER' || sceneName === 'LUCIFER_GATE' || sceneName === 'PATH') Audio8Bit.setMood('lobotomy');
    else if (sceneName === 'WRAITH') { Audio8Bit.setMood('lobotomy'); Audio8Bit.sfx.eerie(); }
    else if (sceneName === 'TRIALS') Audio8Bit.setMood('trials');
    else if (sceneName === 'ENDING') {
      if (state.endingType === 'good') {
        Audio8Bit.setMood(subBeat === 0 ? 'puppetBox' : 'endingGood');
      } else {
        Audio8Bit.setMood(subBeat === 0 ? 'burnBrother' : 'oldDoll');
      }
    }

    if (sceneName === 'WOODS' && subBeat === 1) Audio8Bit.sfx.danger();
    if (sceneName === 'ENDING' && subBeat === 0) {
      Audio8Bit.sfx.fire();
      if (state.endingType === 'good') {
        Audio8Bit.sfx.witchScream();
      } else {
        Audio8Bit.sfx.brotherScream();
        if (window._witchLaughTimer) clearTimeout(window._witchLaughTimer);
        window._witchLaughTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          if (state.scene === 'ENDING' && state.endingType === 'bad' && state.subBeat === 0) {
            Audio8Bit.sfx.witchLaugh(2);
          }
        }, 3300);
      }
    }
    if (sceneName === 'ENDING' && state.endingType === 'good' && subBeat === 1) Audio8Bit.sfx.win();
    if (sceneName === 'ENDING' && state.endingType === 'bad' && subBeat === 1) Audio8Bit.sfx.lose();

    syncLayoutUI();
  }

  function advanceFlow() {
    Audio8Bit.init();
    const dlg = getActiveDialogue();
    if (dlg.text && state.typeIdx < dlg.text.length) {
      state.typeIdx = dlg.text.length;
      document.getElementById('dialogueText').textContent = dlg.text;
      Audio8Bit.sfx.click();
      return;
    }

    Audio8Bit.sfx.confirm();
    if (state.scene === 'TITLE') setScene('HOME', 0);
    else if (state.scene === 'HOME') setScene('WOODS', 0);
    else if (state.scene === 'WOODS') {
      if (state.subBeat === 0) setScene('WOODS', 1);
      else setScene('SORROW', 0);
    } else if (state.scene === 'SORROW') {
      state.luciferCursor = 0;
      setScene('LUCIFER', 0);
    } else if (state.scene === 'LUCIFER') {
      Audio8Bit.sfx.eerie();
      setScene('PATH', 0);
    } else if (state.scene === 'PATH') {
      setScene('TRIALS', 0);
    } else if (state.scene === 'WRAITH') {
      HangmanModule.open();
    } else if (state.scene === 'ENDING') {
      if (state.subBeat === 0) {
        setScene('ENDING', 1);
      }
    }
  }

  function goBackFlow() {
    Audio8Bit.init();
    Audio8Bit.sfx.click();
    if (state.scene === 'HOME') setScene('TITLE', 0);
    else if (state.scene === 'WOODS') {
      if (state.subBeat === 1) setScene('WOODS', 0);
      else setScene('HOME', 0);
    } else if (state.scene === 'SORROW') setScene('WOODS', 1);
    else if (state.scene === 'LUCIFER') setScene('SORROW', 0);
    else if (state.scene === 'PATH') setScene('LUCIFER', 0);
    else if (state.scene === 'LUCIFER_GATE') setScene('TRIALS', 0);
    else if (state.scene === 'WRAITH') setScene('LUCIFER_GATE', 0);
    else if (state.scene === 'ENDING') {
      if (state.subBeat === 1) setScene('ENDING', 0);
      else setScene('TRIALS', 0);
    }
  }

  function handleTrialResult(trialNum, won) {
    document.getElementById('moduleModal').classList.remove('open');
    if (won) {
      if (trialNum === 1) state.trials.t1 = true;
      if (trialNum === 2) state.trials.t2 = true;
      Audio8Bit.sfx.win();
      syncLayoutUI();
      if (state.trials.t1 && state.trials.t2) {
        state.endingType = 'good';
        setScene('ENDING', 0);
      }
    } else {
      if (trialNum === 2) {
        state.endingType = 'bad';
        setScene('ENDING', 0);
      } else {
        Audio8Bit.sfx.danger();
        syncLayoutUI();
      }
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 6. PIXEL-ART SCENE RENDERERS
  // =========================================================================
  function drawCloud(c, x, y, w, col = '#ffffff', shade = '#d4e6f5') {
    px(c, x + 5, y, w - 10, 5, col);
    px(c, x + 2, y + 3, w - 4, 6, col);
    px(c, x, y + 6, w, 5, col);
    px(c, x + 2, y + 10, w - 4, 2, shade);
  }

  function drawPine(c, cx, baseY, h, cDark, cMid, cHi) {
    px(c, cx - 3, baseY - 12, 6, 12, '#3d2415');
    px(c, cx - 1, baseY - 12, 2, 12, '#54331e');
    const tiers = 4;
    for (let i = 0; i < tiers; i++) {
      const ty = baseY - 10 - i * Math.floor(h / 4.4);
      const halfW = Math.floor((tiers - i + 1) * (h * 0.145));
      const rows = Math.floor(h / 3.1);
      for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        const w = Math.max(2, halfW - Math.floor(r * 0.92));
        px(c, cx - w, ty - r, w * 2, 1, cDark);
        if (w > 3) px(c, cx - w + 2, ty - r, w * 2 - 4, 1, cMid);
        if (w > 5 && r % 2 === 0) px(c, cx - w + 3, ty - r, Math.floor(w * 0.85), 1, cHi);
      }
    }
  }

  // Animated 8-bit pixel fire helper (for BURN THE WITCH & BURN THE BROTHER!)
  function drawPixelFlames(c, cx, baseY, width, height, seedOffset = 0) {
    const cols = Math.floor(width / 4);
    for (let i = 0; i < cols; i++) {
      const fx = cx - width / 2 + i * 4;
      const distNorm = Math.abs((i + 0.5) / cols - 0.5) * 2; // 0 center, 1 edge
      const wave = Math.sin(state.tick * 0.24 + i * 1.3 + seedOffset) * 7 + Math.cos(state.tick * 0.17 + i * 2.1) * 4;
      const colH = Math.max(8, Math.floor((height * (1 - distNorm * 0.45)) + wave));

      // Outer crimson-red flame
      px(c, fx, baseY - colH, 4, colH, '#d93025');
      // Mid bright orange flame
      if (colH > 8) px(c, fx + 1, baseY - Math.floor(colH * 0.78), 3, Math.floor(colH * 0.78), '#ff7b1c');
      // Inner golden-yellow core
      if (colH > 14) px(c, fx + 1, baseY - Math.floor(colH * 0.52), 2, Math.floor(colH * 0.52), '#ffe047');
      // White-hot base
      if (colH > 18 && distNorm < 0.65) px(c, fx + 1, baseY - Math.floor(colH * 0.24), 2, Math.floor(colH * 0.24), '#fff7cc');
    }
  }

  // --- SCENE 1: TITLE SCREEN (Exact High-Craft Pixel Art Cover + Subtle Live Effects) ---
  function renderTitle(c, W, H) {
    px(c, 0, 0, W, H, '#050508');

    if (titleArtReady) {
      // Draw cleaned pixel-art title cover filling the frame crisply
      c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      const aspect = titleArtImg.width / titleArtImg.height;
      let dw = W - 12;
      let dh = Math.round(dw / aspect);
      if (dh > H - 10) {
        dh = H - 10;
        dw = Math.round(dh * aspect);
      }
      const dx = Math.floor((W - dw) / 2);
      const dy = Math.floor((H - dh) / 2);
      c.drawImage(titleArtImg, dx, dy, dw, dh);

      // Subtle pulsing arcade shimmer over the "- START -" area
      const pulse = (Math.sin(state.tick * 0.1) + 1) * 0.5;
      c.fillStyle = `rgba(245, 185, 53, ${(0.05 + pulse * 0.13).toFixed(3)})`;
      c.fillRect(Math.floor(W / 2 - 96), Math.floor(dy + dh * 0.372), 192, 36);

      // Animated flanking gold pixel cursor arrows beside "- START -"
      const shift = Math.round(Math.sin(state.tick * 0.14) * 4);
      c.font = 'bold 20px "Silkscreen", monospace';
      c.textAlign = 'center';
      c.textBaseline = 'top';
      c.fillStyle = '#f5b935';
      c.fillText('▸', W / 2 - 110 + shift, Math.floor(dy + dh * 0.385));
      c.fillText('◂', W / 2 + 110 - shift, Math.floor(dy + dh * 0.385));

      // Custom crisp pixel credit footer
      c.font = 'bold 14px "Press Start 2P", "Silkscreen", monospace';
      c.textAlign = 'center';
      c.textBaseline = 'top';
      c.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      c.fillText('@ngaiquaithu2026', W / 2, Math.floor(dy + dh * 0.958));
    }

    // Crisp outer pixel border
    px(c, 4, 4, W - 8, 1, '#4b4963');
    px(c, 4, H - 5, W - 8, 1, '#4b4963');
    px(c, 4, 4, 1, H - 8, '#4b4963');
    px(c, W - 5, 4, 1, H - 8, '#4b4963');

    // Subtle drifting white pixel dust motes
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      const mx = (i * 41 + Math.sin(state.tick * 0.02 + i) * 4 + W) % (W - 20) + 10;
      const my = H - 20 - ((state.tick * 0.25 + i * 31) % (H - 36));
      px(c, mx, my, 1, 1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35)');
    }
  }

  // --- SCENE 2: HOME & GOOD ENDING BEAT 2 (REUNION) ---
  function renderHome(c, W, H, isVictory = false) {
    px(c, 0, 0, W, 96, '#5eb2f2');
    px(c, 0, 44, W, 52, '#86ccf9');
    px(c, 0, 74, W, 32, '#bce6ff');

    const drift = (state.tick * 0.12) % (W + 70);
    drawCloud(c, (150 + drift) % (W + 70) - 50, 12, 50, '#ffffff', '#c2e4fc');
    drawCloud(c, (34 + drift * 0.65) % (W + 70) - 50, 26, 38, '#eef9ff', '#b9e0fa');

    drawPine(c, 54, 142, 92, '#1a4a2b', '#26663a', '#38854b');
    drawPine(c, 88, 138, 102, '#174226', '#225e35', '#327844');
    drawPine(c, 132, 136, 94, '#1a4a2b', '#26663a', '#38854b');
    drawPine(c, 176, 140, 104, '#174226', '#225e35', '#327844');
    drawPine(c, 210, 144, 92, '#1a4a2b', '#26663a', '#38854b');

    px(c, 0, 138, W, 72, '#4a9935');
    px(c, 0, 148, W, 62, '#60b542');
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
      const gx = (i * 31 + 9) % (W - 14) + 7;
      const gy = 154 + (i * 19) % 48;
      px(c, gx, gy, 3, 2, '#3c7d28');
      px(c, gx + 1, gy - 2, 1, 2, '#83d65c');
      if (i % 5 === 0) px(c, gx + 4, gy - 1, 2, 2, i % 10 === 0 ? '#ffe570' : '#ffffff');
    }

    // Cozy Wooden Cottage
    px(c, 166, 56, 16, 26, '#7a7570');
    px(c, 164, 54, 20, 4, '#54504c');
    for (let r = 0; r < 5; r++) px(c, 166, 58 + r * 4, 16, 1, '#54504c');
    const sm = (state.tick * 0.24) % 26;
    px(c, 172 + Math.sin(state.tick * 0.09) * 2, 48 - sm * 0.7, 6, 5, '#dde3eb');
    px(c, 176 + Math.cos(state.tick * 0.07) * 3, 38 - sm * 0.9, 8, 6, '#f0f5fa');

    px(c, 88, 96, 98, 54, '#eddab7');
    px(c, 88, 96, 98, 4, '#c7b08b');
    px(c, 86, 94, 102, 4, '#6e4526');
    px(c, 88, 96, 4, 54, '#6e4526');
    px(c, 182, 96, 4, 54, '#6e4526');
    px(c, 88, 120, 98, 3, '#6e4526');

    for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) {
      const rw = 4 + i * 2.3;
      px(c, 137 - rw / 2, 50 + i, rw, 2, '#4a2b14');
      if (rw > 10) px(c, 137 - (rw - 8) / 2, 52 + i, rw - 8, 2, '#804e28');
      if (rw > 20) px(c, 137 - (rw - 18) / 2, 56 + i, rw - 18, 2, '#eddab7');
    }
    px(c, 129, 76, 16, 16, '#59371c');
    px(c, 131, 78, 12, 12, '#627d99');
    px(c, 136, 78, 2, 12, '#59371c');
    px(c, 131, 83, 12, 2, '#59371c');
    px(c, 114, 114, 26, 36, '#59371c');
    px(c, 117, 117, 20, 33, '#8f572c');
    for (let dx = 121; dx < 136; dx += 4) px(c, dx, 117, 1, 33, '#6b3e1c');
    px(c, 132, 133, 3, 3, '#f5c23b');
    px(c, 152, 120, 20, 18, '#59371c');
    px(c, 154, 122, 16, 14, '#627d99');
    px(c, 161, 122, 2, 14, '#59371c');
    px(c, 154, 128, 16, 2, '#59371c');
    px(c, 120, 153, 14, 5, '#a8a39b');
    px(c, 114, 161, 16, 5, '#96928a');

    // Oak trees
    px(c, 0, 48, 26, 122, '#5c361a');
    px(c, 7, 52, 8, 114, '#7a4925');
    px(c, W - 26, 54, 26, 116, '#5c361a');
    px(c, W - 18, 58, 8, 108, '#7a4925');
    const canopy = (cx, cy, r) => {
      px(c, cx - r, cy - r * 0.6, r * 2, r * 1.3, '#1d5227');
      px(c, cx - r + 4, cy - r * 0.8, r * 2 - 8, r * 1.4, '#2d7536');
      px(c, cx - r + 8, cy - r * 0.6, r * 1.4, r * 0.8, '#46a147');
    };
    canopy(22, 24, 40);
    canopy(62, 12, 28);
    canopy(W - 22, 28, 40);
    canopy(W - 60, 14, 25);
    canopy(10, 194, 25);
    canopy(W - 10, 194, 25);

    const hopB = Math.abs(Math.sin(state.tick * 0.14)) * 4;
    const hopS = Math.abs(Math.cos(state.tick * 0.14)) * 4;
    const hopC = Math.abs(Math.sin(state.tick * 0.18 + 1)) * 2.5;
    px(c, 58, 188, 36, 4, 'rgba(15,35,12,0.4)');
    px(c, 158, 188, 38, 4, 'rgba(15,35,12,0.4)');
    px(c, 114, 190, 28, 4, 'rgba(15,35,12,0.4)');

    drawSprite(c, SPR_BROTHER_HAPPY, 54, 146 - hopB, 2, 'color');
    drawSprite(c, SPR_CAT, 114, 166 - hopC, 2, 'color');
    drawSprite(c, SPR_SISTER_HAPPY, 156, 144 - hopS, 2, 'color');

    if (isVictory) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const hx = 42 + i * 36;
        const hy = 128 - ((state.tick * 0.75 + i * 24) % 58);
        px(c, hx, hy, 2, 2, '#f0546a'); px(c, hx + 3, hy, 2, 2, '#f0546a');
        px(c, hx - 1, hy + 1, 7, 2, '#f0546a');
        px(c, hx, hy + 3, 5, 2, '#f0546a');
        px(c, hx + 1, hy + 5, 3, 1, '#f0546a');
      }
    }
  }

  // --- SCENE 3: DEEP WOODS ---
  function renderWoods(c, W, H) {
    const sx = state.shakeFrames > 0 ? (state.shakeFrames % 2 ? -2 : 2) : 0;
    px(c, 0, 0, W, H, '#1e1710');
    [34, 68, 108, 154, 192, 224].forEach((tx, idx) => {
      px(c, tx + sx, 0, 10 + (idx % 2) * 4, 165, idx % 2 ? '#2b2116' : '#36291b');
    });
    px(c, 0, 152, W, 60, '#3a2d1f');
    ditherRect(c, 0, 152, W, 14, '#292016', '#3a2d1f', 0.5);

    px(c, 0, 0, 22, H, '#4a3925');
    px(c, 16, 0, 6, H, '#2e2215');
    px(c, W - 22, 0, 22, H, '#4a3925');
    px(c, W - 22, 0, 6, H, '#2e2215');

    if (state.subBeat === 0) {
      const walkBob = Math.sin(state.tick * 0.1) > 0 ? 0 : 1;
      drawSprite(c, SPR_BROTHER_SCARED, 48, 106 + walkBob, 3, 'color');
      if (Math.floor(state.tick / 28) % 3 !== 0) {
        px(c, 196, 154, 3, 2, '#d58cff');
        px(c, 204, 154, 3, 2, '#d58cff');
      }
    } else {
      const st = state.sceneTick;
      // 3-Beat Magic Wand Capture Choreography with exact Wand Muzzle Socket:
      // Entry (0..22): Witch glides out from right bushes & extends straight arm holding Magic Wand
      // Beat 1 (22..44): High-contrast violet/cyan/gold spell beam fires from exact Wand Muzzle (muzzleX, muzzleY)
      // Beat 2 (44..72): Glowing magic binding rings lock tightly around Brother & lift him slightly
      // Beat 3 (72..118+): Magic tether pulls bound Brother toward Witch & vanishes him in bright violet/cyan smoke!
      const easeOut = (v) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - v, 2);
      const easeInOut = (v) => v < 0.5 ? 2 * v * v : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * v + 2, 2) / 2;

      const entryP = Math.min(1, st / 22);
      const beamP = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (st - 22) / 22));
      const bindP = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (st - 44) / 28));
      const pullP = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (st - 72) / 36));
      const vanished = st >= 108;

      const witchX = Math.floor(204 - easeOut(entryP) * 58) + sx;
      const witchY = 86 + (Math.sin(state.tick * 0.1) > 0 ? 0 : 1);

      // Brother position: steps back on entry, lifted slightly when bound, pulled toward Witch on Beat 3
      const tremble = (st >= 24 && !vanished) ? (Math.floor(state.tick / 3) % 2 ? -1 : 1) : 0;
      const baseBroX = Math.floor(48 - easeOut(entryP) * 10);
      const broX = Math.floor(baseBroX + easeInOut(pullP) * 44) + tremble + sx;
      const liftY = bindP > 0 ? Math.floor(Math.sin(Math.min(1, bindP) * Math.PI * 0.5) * 8 + Math.sin(state.tick * 0.2) * 2) : 0;
      const broY = 106 - liftY;
      const broCx = broX + 34;
      const broCy = broY + 34;

      // 1. Draw Brother (flickers rapidly right before vanishing at end of Beat 3)
      const showBro = !vanished && (pullP < 0.72 || Math.floor(state.tick / 2) % 2 === 0);
      if (showBro) {
        const broSpr = st >= 22 ? SPR_BROTHER_TERRIFIED : SPR_BROTHER_SCARED;
        drawSprite(c, broSpr, broX, broY, 3, 'color');
      }

      // 2. Draw Witch
      drawSprite(c, SPR_WITCH, witchX, witchY, 3, 'color');

      // 3. Straight Purple Arm + Magic Wand + Exact Muzzle/Socket Anchor
      const armP = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (st - 4) / 18));
      let muzzleX = witchX + 6;
      let muzzleY = witchY + 56;
      if (armP > 0) {
        const armY = witchY + 57;
        const armStart = witchX + 16;
        const armLen = Math.floor(18 * easeOut(armP));
        const handX = armStart - armLen;

        // Straight purple sleeve
        px(c, handX, armY - 4, armLen + 10, 9, '#0c0a12');
        px(c, handX + 1, armY - 3, armLen + 8, 4, '#754899');
        px(c, handX + 1, armY + 1, armLen + 8, 3, '#4a2a63');

        // Pale pixel hand gripping wand
        px(c, handX - 6, armY - 4, 7, 9, '#0c0a12');
        px(c, handX - 5, armY - 3, 5, 7, '#e6bcbd');

        // Carved Magic Wand pointing straight left
        px(c, handX - 22, armY - 2, 17, 5, '#0c0a12');
        px(c, handX - 21, armY - 1, 15, 3, '#7a4420');
        px(c, handX - 18, armY - 1, 2, 3, '#ffe45e'); // gold wand band
        px(c, handX - 11, armY - 1, 2, 3, '#ffe45e'); // gold wand band

        // Exact Muzzle / Socket at crystal wand tip!
        muzzleX = handX - 24;
        muzzleY = armY;
        const glowPulse = Math.floor(state.tick / 4) % 2;
        px(c, muzzleX - 3, muzzleY - 4, 7, 8, '#0c0a12');
        px(c, muzzleX - 2, muzzleY - 3, 5, 6, glowPulse ? '#d966ff' : '#4ff5e8');
        px(c, muzzleX - 1, muzzleY - 2, 3, 4, '#ffffff');
      }

      // 4. BEAT 1 (st 22..44) & TETHER (st 44..108): Spell Beam / Tether originating strictly at (muzzleX, muzzleY)
      if (st >= 22 && !vanished) {
        const curEndX = st < 44 ? Math.floor(muzzleX + (broCx - muzzleX) * easeOut(beamP)) : broCx;
        const curEndY = st < 44 ? Math.floor(muzzleY + (broCy - muzzleY) * easeOut(beamP)) : broCy;

        // Muzzle flare burst at exact wand tip
        const fl = 4 + (Math.floor(state.tick / 3) % 3) * 2;
        px(c, muzzleX - fl, muzzleY - 1, fl * 2, 2, '#ffe45e');
        px(c, muzzleX - 1, muzzleY - fl, 2, fl * 2, '#4ff5e8');
        px(c, muzzleX - 2, muzzleY - 2, 4, 4, '#ffffff');

        // Stepped 8-bit glowing magic beam from Muzzle -> Target
        const steps = 18;
        for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
          const f = i / steps;
          const bx = Math.floor(muzzleX + (curEndX - muzzleX) * f);
          const wave = Math.round(Math.sin(f * 10 - state.tick * 0.45) * (st < 44 ? 2.5 : 1.5));
          const by = Math.floor(muzzleY + (curEndY - muzzleY) * f) + wave;
          // High-contrast violet outer glow + electric cyan core + bright gold sparks
          px(c, bx - 2, by - 3, 5, 6, '#b84dff');
          px(c, bx - 1, by - 1, 3, 2, i % 3 === 0 ? '#ffe45e' : '#4ff5e8');
          if ((i + Math.floor(state.tick / 2)) % 5 === 0) {
            px(c, bx, by - 5, 2, 2, '#ffffff');
          }
        }
      }

      // 5. BEAT 2 & 3 (st 44..108): Glowing Violet/Cyan/Gold Magic Binding Rings Locking Brother!
      if (st >= 44 && showBro) {
        const ringY1 = broY + 30;
        const ringY2 = broY + 45;
        const ringW = 46;
        const ringX = broX + 12;
        const alt = Math.floor(state.tick / 5) % 2;

        [ringY1, ringY2].forEach((ry, idx) => {
          const colMain = (idx + alt) % 2 === 0 ? '#d966ff' : '#4ff5e8';
          const colHi = (idx + alt) % 2 === 0 ? '#ffe45e' : '#ffffff';
          px(c, ringX - 1, ry - 1, ringW + 2, 6, '#0c0a12');
          px(c, ringX, ry, ringW, 4, colMain);
          px(c, ringX + 2, ry + 1, ringW - 4, 2, colHi);
          // Sparkling rune nodes on ring edges
          px(c, ringX - 3, ry, 3, 3, '#ffe45e');
          px(c, ringX + ringW, ry, 3, 3, '#4ff5e8');
        });

        // Rising high-contrast magic aura particles around bound Brother
        for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
          const pxX = broX + 12 + ((i * 11 + state.tick) % 44);
          const pxY = broY + 56 - ((state.tick * 1.1 + i * 13) % 52);
          px(c, pxX, pxY, 2, 2, i % 2 === 0 ? '#4ff5e8' : '#ffe45e');
        }
      }

      // 6. BEAT 3 FINALE (st 88+): Dramatic Violet & Cyan Magic Smoke Poof as Brother Vanishes!
      if (st >= 88) {
        const smokeAge = st - 88;
        const puffCount = vanished ? 10 : 6;
        for (let i = 0; i < puffCount; i++) {
          const ang = (i / puffCount) * Math.PI * 2 + state.tick * 0.05;
          const rad = vanished ? Math.min(34, 8 + (smokeAge - 20) * 0.9) : (10 + (smokeAge % 12));
          const sxP = Math.floor(broCx + Math.cos(ang) * rad);
          const syP = Math.floor(broCy + Math.sin(ang) * rad * 0.7 - (vanished ? (smokeAge - 20) * 0.35 : 0));
          const sz = vanished ? Math.max(2, 10 - Math.floor((smokeAge - 20) / 5)) : 6;
          if (sz > 1 && syP > 10) {
            px(c, sxP - sz / 2, syP - sz / 2, sz, sz, i % 3 === 0 ? '#ffe45e' : (i % 2 ? '#d966ff' : '#4ff5e8'));
          }
        }
      }

      // Startled '!' bubble right when the spell hits
      if (st >= 22 && st <= 64) {
        const ex = broX + 32;
        const ey = broY - 15;
        px(c, ex - 2, ey - 1, 8, 13, '#0c0a12');
        px(c, ex - 1, ey, 6, 11, '#fff3b0');
        px(c, ex + 1, ey + 1, 2, 5, '#d93025');
        px(c, ex + 1, ey + 8, 2, 2, '#d93025');
      }
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      const bx = 148 + i * 16;
      const by = 146 + (i % 2) * 8;
      px(c, bx, by, 26, 66, '#1a1e13');
      px(c, bx + 3, by + 3, 20, 60, '#272d1c');
      px(c, bx + 6, by + 6, 12, 8, '#363f26');
    }
  }

  // --- SCENE 4: SORROW & BAD ENDING BEAT 2 (SISTER CRYING WITH EMBERS) ---
  function renderSorrow(c, W, H, isBadEnding = false) {
    px(c, 0, 0, W, H, '#09090e');
    [42, 80, 124, 168, 208].forEach((tx, idx) => {
      px(c, tx, 0, 10, 160, idx % 2 ? '#14151c' : '#1b1d26');
    });
    px(c, 0, 0, 20, H, '#2a2c36');
    px(c, 15, 0, 5, H, '#181a21');
    px(c, W - 20, 0, 20, H, '#2a2c36');
    px(c, W - 20, 0, 5, H, '#181a21');

    px(c, 20, 160, W - 40, 50, '#323540');
    px(c, 36, 152, W - 72, 46, '#484d5c');
    ditherRect(c, 36, 152, W - 72, 8, '#323540', '#484d5c', 0.5);
    px(c, 70, 180, 74, 10, '#21232b');
    px(c, 160, 182, 42, 8, '#21232b');

    drawSprite(c, SPR_SISTER_CRY, 68, 106, 3, 'mono');
    drawSprite(c, SPR_CAT_CRY, 158, 140, 3, 'mono');

    // Animated falling blue pixel tears
    const drop = (state.tick * 0.5) % 14;
    px(c, 92, 138 + drop, 2, 3, '#5ec8f2');
    px(c, 114, 140 + ((drop + 6) % 14), 2, 3, '#5ec8f2');
    px(c, 168, 160 + ((drop + 4) % 10), 2, 2, '#5ec8f2');

    if (isBadEnding) {
      // Drifting glowing orange ash/embers & faint rain in the aftermath
      for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
        const ex = (i * 29 + state.tick * 0.4) % (W - 40) + 20;
        const ey = H - ((i * 23 + state.tick * 0.7) % H);
        px(c, ex, ey, 2, 2, i % 2 ? '#ff6a2b' : '#ffb84d');
      }
    }
  }

  // --- SCENE 5 & PRE-HANGMAN GATE: LUCIFER (Dark Silhouette with Piercing Eyes, Clean Smooth Head) ---
  function renderLucifer(c, W, H) {
    const DARK = '#2c2638';
    const DEEP = '#211c2b';
    const CREAM = '#f2f5d8';
    const PALE = '#dde1c8';
    const cx = Math.floor(W / 2);

    // 1. Deep muted plum-charcoal room walls
    px(c, 0, 0, W, H, DARK);

    // 2. Ornate 1-bit dithered side curtains framing the window
    ditherRect(c, 18, 0, 28, 144, DARK, PALE, 0.5);
    ditherRect(c, W - 46, 0, 28, 144, DARK, PALE, 0.5);
    px(c, 18, 0, 10, 18, DARK);
    px(c, 22, 18, 6, 32, DARK);
    px(c, W - 28, 0, 10, 18, DARK);
    px(c, W - 28, 18, 6, 32, DARK);
    ditherRect(c, 18, 92, 26, 48, PALE, DARK, 0.5);
    ditherRect(c, W - 44, 92, 26, 48, PALE, DARK, 0.5);

    // 3. Bright pale cream-yellow backlit window with dithered inner frame
    const wx = 44, wy = 0, ww = W - 88, wh = 132;
    ditherRect(c, wx - 4, wy, ww + 8, wh + 4, DARK, PALE, 0.5);
    px(c, wx, wy, ww, wh, DARK);
    px(c, wx + 2, wy, ww - 4, wh - 2, CREAM);

    // Crisp vertical center mullion + 2 dithered horizontal mullions
    px(c, cx - 2, wy, 4, wh, DARK);
    [16, 76].forEach(my => {
      px(c, wx + 2, my, ww - 4, 2, DARK);
      ditherRect(c, wx + 2, my + 2, ww - 4, 2, CREAM, DARK, 0.5);
    });
    ditherRect(c, wx + 2, wh - 5, ww - 4, 4, CREAM, DARK, 0.5);

    // 4. Curved High-Back Armchair with fine vertical-rib + checkerboard pixel dithering
    for (let y = 116; y < H; y++) {
      const dy = y - 116;
      const halfArch = Math.min(92, Math.floor(48 + Math.sqrt(dy * 52)));
      const x0 = cx - halfArch;
      const x1 = cx + halfArch;
      px(c, x0 - 2, y, 3, 1, PALE);
      px(c, x1, y, 3, 1, PALE);
      for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
        const edgeDist = Math.min(x - x0, x1 - 1 - x);
        const light = edgeDist < 6
          ? ((x + y) % 2 === 0)
          : ((x % 3 !== 0) && ((y % 2 === 0) || (x % 2 === 0)));
        c.fillStyle = light ? PALE : DARK;
        c.fillRect(x, y, 1, 1);
      }
    }

    // 5. Lucifer's Rounded Head, Two Slender Side Hair Strands & Suit Silhouette (exact v2 style!)
    const headCy = 86, headRx = 35, headRy = 42;
    for (let y = headCy - headRy; y <= headCy + 28; y++) {
      const ny = (y - headCy) / headRy;
      const hw = ny < 0
        ? Math.floor(headRx * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - ny * ny)))
        : headRx - Math.floor(Math.max(0, (y - (headCy + 14)) * 0.25));
      px(c, cx - hw, y, hw * 2, 1, DARK);
    }
    // Two slender hanging side hair strands framing the neck (exact v2 detail!)
    px(c, cx - 33, 98, 7, 38, DARK);
    px(c, cx + 26, 98, 7, 38, DARK);
    ditherRect(c, cx - 26, 114, 5, 16, DARK, PALE, 0.5);
    ditherRect(c, cx + 21, 114, 5, 16, DARK, PALE, 0.5);
    // Neck & broad tailored shoulders
    px(c, cx - 21, 110, 42, 26, DARK);
    for (let y = 132; y < H; y++) {
      const sw = Math.min(78, 36 + Math.floor((y - 132) * 1.45));
      px(c, cx - sw, y, sw * 2, 1, DARK);
    }

    // 6. Hypnotic Almond-Shaped Staring Eyes (Warm Amber-Brown Ringed Iris + Subtle Blink!)
    const blinking = (state.tick % 210) > 204;
    const gazeX = Math.round(Math.sin(state.tick * 0.025));
    const eyeY = 98;
    const drawEye = (ex) => {
      if (blinking) {
        px(c, ex - 8, eyeY + 3, 16, 2, '#4a415c');
        px(c, ex - 6, eyeY + 4, 12, 1, DEEP);
        return;
      }
      px(c, ex - 8, eyeY + 2, 16, 4, CREAM);
      px(c, ex - 6, eyeY + 1, 12, 6, CREAM);
      px(c, ex - 4, eyeY, 8, 8, CREAM);
      px(c, ex - 7, eyeY + 1, 14, 1, DEEP);
      const ix = ex - 3 + gazeX;
      px(c, ix, eyeY + 1, 7, 6, '#5c351e');
      px(c, ix + 1, eyeY + 2, 5, 4, '#b5783a');
      px(c, ix + 2, eyeY + 2, 3, 3, '#211824');
      px(c, ix + 1, eyeY + 2, 1, 1, '#ffffff');
      px(c, ix + 4, eyeY + 4, 1, 1, '#e8be7d');
    };
    drawEye(cx - 15);
    drawEye(cx + 15);

    // 7. Elegant Steepled Pale Hands & Crisp Cuffs in Foreground
    px(c, cx - 54, 182, 14, 28, CREAM);
    ditherRect(c, cx - 52, 184, 10, 24, CREAM, DARK, 0.25);
    px(c, cx + 40, 182, 14, 28, CREAM);
    ditherRect(c, cx + 42, 184, 10, 24, CREAM, DARK, 0.25);

    for (let r = 0; r < 22; r++) {
      const hw = Math.min(44, 10 + r * 2);
      px(c, cx - hw, 158 + r, hw * 2, 1, CREAM);
    }
    px(c, cx - 44, 180, 88, 16, PALE);
    px(c, cx - 22, 164, 18, 1, DARK);
    px(c, cx + 4, 164, 18, 1, DARK);
    px(c, cx - 28, 170, 24, 1, DARK);
    px(c, cx + 4, 170, 24, 1, DARK);
    px(c, cx - 18, 176, 36, 2, DARK);
    px(c, cx - 26, 183, 52, 2, DARK);
    ditherRect(c, cx - 34, 186, 68, 8, PALE, DARK, 0.5);
    px(c, cx - 18, 194, 36, 16, DARK);
    px(c, cx - 12, 190, 24, 6, DARK);
  }

  // --- MYSTERIOUS FIGURE: CANDLE WRAITH IN SNOWY FOREST (matching 1000032079.jpg) ---
  function renderWraith(c, W, H) {
    const cx = Math.floor(W / 2);
    // Pitch-black night sky
    px(c, 0, 0, W, H, '#050507');

    // Vertical 1-bit dithered dark forest tree trunks flanking left & right
    const leftTrees = [[0, 18], [22, 14], [40, 12], [56, 10]];
    const rightTrees = [[W - 18, 18], [W - 36, 14], [W - 52, 12], [W - 66, 10]];
    [...leftTrees, ...rightTrees].forEach(([tx, tw], idx) => {
      px(c, tx, 0, tw, 136, idx % 2 === 0 ? '#2b2b30' : '#1b1b20');
      ditherRect(c, tx + 2, 0, Math.max(2, tw - 4), 136, '#050507', '#4a4a52', 0.35);
    });

    // Tiny falling white pixel snow specks
    for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
      const sx = (i * 37 + Math.sin(state.tick * 0.02 + i) * 6 + W) % W;
      const sy = (i * 29 + state.tick * 0.45) % 134;
      px(c, sx, sy, 1, 1, '#ffffff');
    }

    // Pure white snowy ground horizon
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
      const hillY = 132 + Math.round(Math.sin(x * 0.025) * 4);
      px(c, x, hillY, 1, H - hillY, '#ffffff');
    }

    // Sharp dark ground cast shadow beneath the Candle Wraith
    px(c, cx - 36, 174, 72, 3, '#5c5c63');
    px(c, cx - 24, 176, 48, 2, '#1a1a1f');

    // Tall ghostly white shroud with wind-blown tattered tendrils streaming left!
    const sway = Math.sin(state.tick * 0.07) * 2;
    // Main column cloak
    for (let y = 44; y <= 174; y++) {
      const progress = (y - 44) / 130;
      const cw = Math.floor(11 + progress * 10);
      px(c, cx - cw, y, cw * 2, 1, '#ffffff');
      // Eerie vertical black ink fold lines inside the white cloak
      if (y > 76 && y < 146) {
        px(c, cx - 4, y, 2, 1, '#050507');
        if (y > 92 && y < 134) px(c, cx + 3, y, 2, 1, '#050507');
        if (y > 106 && y < 138) px(c, cx - 8, y, 1, 1, '#050507');
      }
    }

    // Dramatic wind-blown white tendrils streaming far to the left (exact 1000032079.jpg vibe!)
    const tendrils = [
      { y0: 54, len: 52, drop: 14, thick: 2 },
      { y0: 66, len: 64, drop: 18, thick: 2 },
      { y0: 82, len: 48, drop: 16, thick: 2 },
      { y0: 100, len: 76, drop: 26, thick: 2 },
      { y0: 118, len: 58, drop: 20, thick: 1 },
    ];
    tendrils.forEach((td, idx) => {
      const flutter = Math.sin(state.tick * 0.12 + idx * 1.4) * 3;
      for (let i = 0; i < td.len; i++) {
        const f = i / td.len;
        const tx = cx - 8 - i;
        const ty = td.y0 + f * td.drop + Math.sin(f * 3.1 + state.tick * 0.09 + idx) * 2.5 + flutter * f;
        const h = f < 0.5 ? td.thick : 1;
        px(c, tx, ty, 2, h, '#ffffff');
      }
    });

    // Pitch-black faceless void hood
    px(c, cx - 7, 30, 14, 34, '#050507');
    px(c, cx - 5, 27, 10, 4, '#050507');
    px(c, cx - 8, 34, 1, 24, '#ffffff');
    px(c, cx + 7, 34, 1, 24, '#ffffff');

    // Iconic Crimson Wreath Crown + 5 Flickering White & Red-Flamed Candles!
    px(c, cx - 12, 23, 24, 6, '#b81d24');
    px(c, cx - 10, 22, 20, 2, '#e62e36');
    px(c, cx - 9, 25, 18, 2, '#7d1116');
    // 5 tiny white candles on the crimson wreath
    const candleOffsets = [-9, -5, 0, 5, 9];
    candleOffsets.forEach((ox, idx) => {
      const ch = (idx === 2) ? 10 : (idx === 1 || idx === 3 ? 8 : 6);
      const cy = 22 - ch;
      px(c, cx + ox - 1, cy, 2, ch, '#ffffff');
      // Animated flickering red-orange flame atop each candle
      const flick = (Math.floor(state.tick / 6) + idx) % 2;
      px(c, cx + ox - 1, cy - 4 - flick, 2, 4, '#e62e2e');
      px(c, cx + ox, cy - 3 - flick, 1, 2, '#ffae42');
    });
  }

  // --- SCENE 6: MOUNTAIN PATH ---
  function renderPath(c, W, H) {
    px(c, 0, 0, W, 108, '#8ba8bd');
    px(c, 0, 50, W, 58, '#a6c0d4');

    const drift = (state.tick * 0.1) % (W + 70);
    drawCloud(c, (18 + drift) % (W + 70) - 50, 14, 64, '#ffffff', '#d6e3ed');
    drawCloud(c, (175 + drift * 0.75) % (W + 70) - 50, 20, 58, '#ffffff', '#d6e3ed');
    drawCloud(c, (88 + drift * 0.5) % (W + 70) - 50, 44, 34, '#f2f7fa', '#cedae3');

    for (let i = 0; i < 82; i++) {
      const mw = 4 + i * 2.15;
      const mx = 192 - mw / 2;
      px(c, mx, 42 + i, mw, 2, '#7d8691');
      px(c, mx + mw * 0.45, 42 + i, mw * 0.55, 2, '#626a75');
      if (i < 24) {
        const snowW = mw * (1 - (i > 16 ? (i - 16) * 0.05 : 0));
        px(c, 192 - snowW / 2, 42 + i, snowW, 2, '#f5f8fc');
      }
    }

    drawPine(c, 28, 158, 110, '#1f542d', '#2e753d', '#44994f');
    drawPine(c, 72, 154, 96, '#174023', '#235e31', '#357d42');
    drawPine(c, 114, 152, 86, '#12331b', '#1b4a26', '#2a6636');
    drawPine(c, 158, 154, 90, '#12331b', '#1b4a26', '#2a6636');
    drawPine(c, 200, 158, 102, '#174023', '#235e31', '#357d42');
    drawPine(c, 236, 162, 116, '#1f542d', '#2e753d', '#44994f');

    px(c, 0, 152, W, 58, '#468a32');
    px(c, 0, 162, W, 48, '#56a33e');
    for (let r = 0; r < 58; r++) {
      const pw = 38 + r * 1.45;
      px(c, W / 2 - pw / 2, 152 + r, pw, 1, '#c99b63');
      px(c, W / 2 - pw / 2 + 4, 152 + r, pw - 8, 1, '#d9af77');
    }
    px(c, 0, 178, 44, 32, '#1d4a26');
    px(c, 8, 186, 48, 24, '#2d6e37');
    px(c, W - 44, 178, 44, 32, '#1d4a26');
    px(c, W - 56, 186, 48, 24, '#2d6e37');

    px(c, W / 2 - 20, 188, 40, 5, 'rgba(50,35,20,0.45)');
    const idle = Math.sin(state.tick * 0.08) > 0 ? 0 : 1;
    drawSprite(c, SPR_SISTER_SAD, W / 2 - 22, 142 + idle, 2, 'color');
  }

  // --- DRAMATIC FIRE ENDING SCENE: 'witch' (BURN THE WITCH!) OR 'brother' (BURN THE BROTHER!) ---
  function renderFireEnding(c, W, H, target) {
    const isWitch = (target === 'witch');
    const sx = state.shakeFrames > 0 ? (state.shakeFrames % 2 ? -2 : 2) : 0;

    // Fiery night sky with warm crimson/orange glow
    px(c, 0, 0, W, H, isWitch ? '#1c1026' : '#140b12');
    ditherRect(c, 0, 55, W, 110, isWitch ? '#1c1026' : '#140b12', isWitch ? '#541e18' : '#4a1216', 0.5);
    ditherRect(c, 0, 110, W, 65, isWitch ? '#541e18' : '#4a1216', '#8a2b14', 0.5);

    // Dark framing forest silhouettes
    px(c, 0, 0, 26, H, '#0c0810');
    px(c, W - 26, 0, 26, H, '#0c0810');
    [38, 72, 186, 218].forEach(tx => px(c, tx, 0, 10, 160, '#170d18'));

    // Scorched clearing ground
    px(c, 0, 160, W, 50, '#241410');
    px(c, 0, 168, W, 42, '#331c14');

    // Wooden stake & stacked firewood pyre in center
    const cx = W / 2 + sx;
    px(c, cx - 5, 58, 10, 116, '#3d2212');
    px(c, cx - 3, 60, 3, 112, '#5e361c');
    // Stacked firewood logs at base
    px(c, cx - 40, 160, 80, 10, '#4f2c16');
    px(c, cx - 34, 152, 68, 10, '#693b1d');
    px(c, cx - 26, 146, 52, 8, '#7d4724');

    // Back flames behind victim
    drawPixelFlames(c, cx, 166, 92, 68, 0);

    // Victim on the stake!
    const panic = Math.round(Math.sin(state.tick * 0.35) * 2);
    if (isWitch) {
      // Witch burning on the pyre!
      drawSprite(c, SPR_WITCH, cx - 36 + panic, 78, 3, 'color');
      // Happy siblings & cat watching safely from the left foreground!
      drawSprite(c, SPR_SISTER_HAPPY, 22, 146, 2, 'color');
      drawSprite(c, SPR_BROTHER_HAPPY, 58, 148, 2, 'color');
      drawSprite(c, SPR_CAT, 198, 168, 2, 'color');
    } else {
      // Older Brother trapped in the fire!
      drawSprite(c, SPR_BROTHER_GALLOWS, cx - 27 + panic, 82, 3, 'color');
      // Wicked Witch cackling in the right foreground shadows!
      drawSprite(c, SPR_WITCH, 184, 128 + Math.sin(state.tick * 0.2) * 2, 2, 'color');
    }

    // Front roaring flames partially engulfing the pyre
    drawPixelFlames(c, cx, 174, 86, 44, 3.1);

    // Rising glowing embers & smoke puffs
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
      const ex = cx - 44 + ((i * 19 + state.tick * 0.6) % 88);
      const ey = 156 - ((state.tick * 1.2 + i * 17) % 138);
      px(c, ex, ey, 2, 2, i % 3 === 0 ? '#fff5b8' : (i % 2 ? '#ff9124' : '#ff402b'));
    }

    // Bold 8-bit Pixel Title Banner at Top: BURN THE WITCH! vs BURN THE BROTHER
    const bannerTxt = isWitch ? 'BURN THE WITCH!' : 'BURN THE BROTHER';
    px(c, 22, 12, W - 44, 24, '#09070d');
    px(c, 24, 14, W - 48, 20, isWitch ? '#ffae33' : '#e63946');
    px(c, 26, 16, W - 52, 16, isWitch ? '#2e1508' : '#24090d');
    c.font = 'bold 11px "Press Start 2P", "Silkscreen", monospace';
    c.textAlign = 'center';
    c.textBaseline = 'top';
    c.fillStyle = isWitch ? '#fff0a6' : '#ff99a4';
    c.fillText(bannerTxt, W / 2, 19);
  }

  // --- SCENE 7 CARD PREVIEWS ---
  function renderWordlePreview(c, W, H) {
    px(c, 0, 0, W, H, '#25545c');
    ditherRect(c, 0, 0, W, H, '#25545c', '#1c4248', 0.25);

    px(c, 10, 8, W - 20, H - 16, '#422a19');
    px(c, 14, 12, W - 28, H - 24, '#d9c49c');
    px(c, 16, 12, W - 34, H - 28, '#f5ead2');
    px(c, 16, 12, 5, H - 28, '#e3d2b1');

    px(c, 26, 18, W - 52, 18, '#d99e26');
    px(c, 28, 20, W - 56, 14, '#543218');
    c.font = 'bold 8px "Silkscreen", monospace';
    c.textAlign = 'center';
    c.fillStyle = '#fff4d6';
    c.fillText('CHALLENGE 1: WORDLE', W / 2, 23);

    for (let row = 0; row < 2; row++) {
      const cy = 43 + row * 19;
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const cx = 34 + i * 22;
        const lit = state.trials.t1 || i < 2;
        px(c, cx, cy, 14, 13, '#3d2817');
        px(c, cx + 1, cy + 1, 12, 11, lit ? '#f5c23b' : '#a89980');
        px(c, cx + 3, cy + 3, 4, 3, lit ? '#ffeb99' : '#bfb199');
      }
      const mx = 176;
      px(c, mx + 3, cy + 10, 3, 5, '#c93838');
      px(c, mx + 8, cy + 10, 3, 5, '#c93838');
      px(c, mx, cy, 14, 12, '#3d2817');
      px(c, mx + 1, cy + 1, 12, 10, '#ffd24c');
    }

    const leftLetters = ['A','B','C','D','E','F','G','H','R','O','L','L'];
    leftLetters.forEach((ch, idx) => {
      const col = idx % 4, row = Math.floor(idx / 4);
      const lx = 32 + col * 20, ly = 86 + row * 17;
      px(c, lx, ly, 17, 15, '#3b2616');
      px(c, lx + 1, ly + 1, 15, 13, '#78573a');
      c.font = 'bold 8px "Silkscreen", monospace';
      c.textAlign = 'center';
      c.fillStyle = '#fff5e0';
      c.fillText(ch, lx + 8.5, ly + 4);
    });

    const rightLetters = ['A','B','C','D','F','G','H','I','M','N','O','P','W','X','Y','Z'];
    rightLetters.forEach((ch, idx) => {
      const col = idx % 4, row = Math.floor(idx / 4);
      const rx = 126 + col * 19, ry = 86 + row * 14;
      px(c, rx, ry, 16, 12, '#3b2616');
      px(c, rx + 1, ry + 1, 14, 10, '#6e4f34');
      c.font = 'bold 7px "Silkscreen", monospace';
      c.textAlign = 'center';
      c.fillStyle = '#fff5e0';
      c.fillText(ch, rx + 8, ry + 2.5);
    });

    drawSprite(c, SPR_SISTER_PORTRAIT, 30, 140, 2, 'color');
    c.font = '7px "Silkscreen", monospace';
    c.textAlign = 'left';
    c.fillStyle = '#3b2412';
    c.fillText('Train and gain', 74, 148);
    c.fillText('experience to', 74, 158);
    c.fillText('solve words', 74, 168);
  }

  function renderHangmanPreview(c, W, H) {
    px(c, 0, 0, W, H, '#0c0a14');
    px(c, 6, 6, W - 12, H - 12, '#4a392c');
    px(c, 8, 8, W - 16, H - 16, '#120f1e');
    [[10,10],[W-18,10],[10,H-18],[W-18,H-18]].forEach(([fx, fy]) => {
      px(c, fx, fy, 8, 2, '#8c6d4e');
      px(c, fx, fy, 2, 8, '#8c6d4e');
    });

    px(c, 16, 14, W - 32, 114, '#211c33');
    px(c, 16, 48, W - 32, 80, '#2c2542');
    ditherRect(c, 16, 76, W - 32, 24, '#2c2542', '#3a3254', 0.5);

    px(c, 16, 14, 10, 114, '#09070f');
    px(c, 26, 26, 14, 3, '#09070f');
    px(c, W - 26, 14, 10, 114, '#09070f');
    px(c, W - 40, 28, 14, 3, '#09070f');

    const gx = 78, gy = 22;
    px(c, gx, gy, 8, 92, '#0f0c18');
    px(c, gx - 4, gy, 56, 7, '#0f0c18');
    px(c, gx - 12, gy + 82, 84, 7, '#0f0c18');
    px(c, gx - 4, gy + 89, 6, 12, '#0f0c18');
    px(c, gx + 58, gy + 89, 6, 12, '#0f0c18');
    px(c, gx + 40, gy + 7, 3, 20, '#85623d');

    const sway = Math.round(Math.sin(state.tick * 0.08));
    drawSprite(c, SPR_BROTHER_GALLOWS, gx + 24 + sway, gy + 40, 2, 'color');

    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      px(c, 42 + i * 27, 138, 18, 3, '#e8e2f5');
    }

    drawSprite(c, SPR_BROTHER_PORTRAIT, 16, 148, 2, 'color');
    c.font = '8px "Silkscreen", monospace';
    c.textAlign = 'left';
    c.fillStyle = '#e8e2f5';
    c.fillText('Rescue before he', 56, 156);
    c.fillText('gets hanged!', 56, 168);
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 7. UI SYNCHRONIZATION & EVENT HANDLERS
  // =========================================================================
  function syncLayoutUI() {
    const navIds = ['navTitle', 'navHome', 'navWoods', 'navSorrow', 'navLucifer', 'navPath', 'navTrials', 'navEnding'];
    const scenes = ['TITLE', 'HOME', 'WOODS', 'SORROW', 'LUCIFER', 'PATH', 'TRIALS', 'ENDING'];
    navIds.forEach((id, idx) => {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      el.textContent = t('nav')[idx];
      el.classList.toggle('active', state.scene === scenes[idx]);
    });

    const bBgm = document.getElementById('btnBgm');
    bBgm.textContent = `BGM: ${Audio8Bit.isBgm() ? t('on') : t('off')}`;
    bBgm.className = `pill-btn ${Audio8Bit.isBgm() ? 'toggle-on' : 'toggle-off'}`;

    const bSfx = document.getElementById('btnSfx');
    bSfx.textContent = `SFX: ${Audio8Bit.isSfx() ? t('on') : t('off')}`;
    bSfx.className = `pill-btn ${Audio8Bit.isSfx() ? 'toggle-on' : 'toggle-off'}`;

    document.getElementById('btnLang').textContent = state.lang.toUpperCase();
    document.getElementById('scanlinesOverlay').classList.toggle('active', state.crt);

    const isTrials = state.scene === 'TRIALS';
    const isTitle = state.scene === 'TITLE';

    mainCanvas.style.display = isTrials ? 'none' : 'block';
    mainCanvas.classList.toggle('tall-title', isTitle);
    mainCanvas.width = isTitle ? 520 : 260;
    mainCanvas.height = isTitle ? 632 : 210;
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

    const dlgPanel = document.getElementById('dialoguePanel');
    dlgPanel.classList.toggle('hidden', isTitle || isTrials);

    const trialsView = document.getElementById('trialsView');
    trialsView.classList.toggle('active', isTrials);

    if (!isTitle && !isTrials) {
      const dlg = getActiveDialogue();
      const spkEl = document.getElementById('speakerLabel');
      spkEl.textContent = dlg.speaker;
      spkEl.className = `speaker-label ${dlg.cls || ''}`;
      document.getElementById('btnBack').textContent = t('back');

      const lucBox = document.getElementById('luciferChoices');
      const endBox = document.getElementById('endingActions');
      const txtEl = document.getElementById('dialogueText');
      const nextHint = document.getElementById('nextHintText');

      if (state.scene === 'LUCIFER') {
        txtEl.style.display = 'none';
        endBox.style.display = 'none';
        lucBox.style.display = 'flex';
        lucBox.innerHTML = [0, 1].map(i => `
          <button class="lucifer-opt ${state.luciferCursor === i ? 'selected' : ''}" data-luc="${i}">
            <span class="opt-arrow">▸</span>
            <span>${t('yes')}</span>
          </button>`).join('');
        lucBox.querySelectorAll('[data-luc]').forEach(btn => {
          btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            state.luciferCursor = Number(btn.getAttribute('data-luc'));
            advanceFlow();
          });
        });
        nextHint.textContent = t('luciferHint');
      } else {
        txtEl.style.display = 'block';
        lucBox.style.display = 'none';
        txtEl.textContent = dlg.text.slice(0, Math.floor(state.typeIdx));

        if (state.scene === 'LUCIFER_GATE') {
          endBox.style.display = 'flex';
          endBox.style.flexWrap = 'wrap';
          if (state.subBeat === 0) {
            endBox.innerHTML = `
              <button class="action-btn primary" id="btnGateYes">▸ ${t('lucGateYes')}</button>
              <button class="action-btn danger" id="btnGateNo">▸ ${t('lucGateNo')}</button>`;
            document.getElementById('btnGateYes').addEventListener('click', () => {
              Audio8Bit.sfx.eerie();
              setScene('WRAITH', 0);
            });
            document.getElementById('btnGateNo').addEventListener('click', () => {
              Audio8Bit.sfx.click();
              setScene('LUCIFER_GATE', 1);
            });
          } else {
            endBox.innerHTML = `<button class="action-btn primary" id="btnGateBackTrials">${t('btnBackWordle')}</button>`;
            document.getElementById('btnGateBackTrials').addEventListener('click', () => {
              Audio8Bit.sfx.click();
              setScene('TRIALS', 0);
            });
          }
          nextHint.textContent = '';
        } else if (state.scene === 'WRAITH') {
          endBox.style.display = 'flex';
          endBox.style.flexWrap = 'wrap';
          endBox.innerHTML = `<button class="action-btn primary" id="btnWraithStart">${t('btnEnterHangman')}</button>`;
          document.getElementById('btnWraithStart').addEventListener('click', () => {
            Audio8Bit.sfx.confirm();
            HangmanModule.open();
          });
          nextHint.textContent = t('clickSpace');
        } else if (state.scene === 'ENDING') {
          endBox.style.display = 'flex';
          endBox.style.flexWrap = 'wrap';
          endBox.innerHTML = `
            <button class="pill-btn ${state.endingType === 'good' ? 'active' : ''}" id="btnEndGood">${t('btnGoodPreview')}</button>
            <button class="pill-btn ${state.endingType === 'bad' ? 'active' : ''}" id="btnEndBad">${t('btnBadPreview')}</button>
            <button class="action-btn primary" id="btnEndReplay">${t('btnPlayAgain')}</button>`;
          document.getElementById('btnEndGood').addEventListener('click', () => {
            state.endingType = 'good'; setScene('ENDING', 0);
          });
          document.getElementById('btnEndBad').addEventListener('click', () => {
            state.endingType = 'bad'; setScene('ENDING', 0);
          });
          document.getElementById('btnEndReplay').addEventListener('click', () => {
            state.trials.t1 = false; state.trials.t2 = false; setScene('TITLE', 0);
          });
          nextHint.textContent = (state.subBeat === 0) ? t('clickSpace') : t('btnToTrials');
        } else {
          endBox.style.display = 'none';
          nextHint.textContent = t('clickSpace');
        }
      }
    }

    if (isTrials) {
      document.getElementById('btnTrialsStory').textContent = t('storyBtn');
      document.getElementById('lblChooseTrial').textContent = t('chooseTrial');
      document.getElementById('btnTrialsReplay').textContent = t('replayTitle');
      document.getElementById('lblTrialsHeroTitle').textContent = t('trialsHeroTitle');
      document.getElementById('lblTrialsHeroDesc').textContent = t('trialsHeroDesc');
      document.getElementById('lblProgress').textContent = t('progress');
      document.getElementById('descT1').textContent = t('t1Desc');
      document.getElementById('descT2').textContent = t('t2Desc');
      document.getElementById('modT1').textContent = t('mod1');
      document.getElementById('modT2').textContent = t('mod2');
      document.getElementById('btnPlayT1').textContent = t('play');
      document.getElementById('btnPlayT2').textContent = t('rescue');
      document.getElementById('btnGoGoodEnd').textContent = t('viewEnd');

      const b1 = document.getElementById('badgeT1');
      b1.textContent = `TRIAL 1: ${state.trials.t1 ? t('cleared') : t('pending')}`;
      b1.classList.toggle('cleared', state.trials.t1);
      document.getElementById('cardTrial1').classList.toggle('cleared', state.trials.t1);

      const b2 = document.getElementById('badgeT2');
      b2.textContent = `TRIAL 2: ${state.trials.t2 ? t('cleared') : t('pending')}`;
      b2.classList.toggle('cleared', state.trials.t2);
      document.getElementById('cardTrial2').classList.toggle('cleared', state.trials.t2);

      document.getElementById('btnGoGoodEnd').style.display = (state.trials.t1 && state.trials.t2) ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
    }

    document.getElementById('lblModalSettings').textContent = t('settings');
    document.getElementById('lblSetBgm').textContent = t('setBgm');
    document.getElementById('lblSetSfx').textContent = t('setSfx');
    document.getElementById('lblSetCrt').textContent = t('setCrt');
    document.getElementById('lblSetLang').textContent = t('setLang');
    document.getElementById('mBtnBgm').textContent = Audio8Bit.isBgm() ? t('on') : t('off');
    document.getElementById('mBtnSfx').textContent = Audio8Bit.isSfx() ? t('on') : t('off');
    document.getElementById('mBtnCrt').textContent = state.crt ? t('on') : t('off');
    document.getElementById('mBtnLang').textContent = t('langLabel');
    document.getElementById('btnCloseSettings').textContent = t('close');
  }

  function openModuleModal(trialNum) {
    Audio8Bit.init();
    Audio8Bit.sfx.confirm();
    if (trialNum === 1 && typeof window.GameBridge.onLaunchTrial1 === 'function') {
      window.GameBridge.onLaunchTrial1();
      return;
    }
    if (trialNum === 2 && typeof window.GameBridge.onLaunchTrial2 === 'function') {
      window.GameBridge.onLaunchTrial2();
      return;
    }
    state.activeModalTrial = trialNum;
    document.getElementById('modModalTitle').textContent = trialNum === 1 ? t('mod1Title') : t('mod2Title');
    document.getElementById('modModalDesc').textContent = trialNum === 1 ? t('mod1Body') : t('mod2Body');
    document.getElementById('modModalHook').textContent = trialNum === 1
      ? 'window.GameBridge.onLaunchTrial1 = () => { /* Wordle */ };\nwindow.GameBridge.completeTrial(1, true);'
      : 'window.GameBridge.onLaunchTrial2 = () => { /* Hangman */ };\nwindow.GameBridge.completeTrial(2, true);';
    document.getElementById('btnSimWin').textContent = t('simWin');
    document.getElementById('btnSimFail').textContent = t('simFail');
    document.getElementById('btnCloseMod').textContent = t('close');
    document.getElementById('moduleModal').classList.add('open');
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('#navPills [data-scene]').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      Audio8Bit.init();
      Audio8Bit.sfx.click();
      setScene(btn.getAttribute('data-scene'), 0);
    });
  });

  const toggleBgm = () => { Audio8Bit.toggleBgm(); syncLayoutUI(); };
  const toggleSfx = () => { Audio8Bit.toggleSfx(); syncLayoutUI(); };
  const toggleLang = () => {
    state.lang = state.lang === 'en' ? 'vi' : 'en';
    Audio8Bit.sfx.click();
    state.typeIdx = 999;
    syncLayoutUI();
  };
  const toggleCrt = () => { state.crt = !state.crt; Audio8Bit.sfx.click(); syncLayoutUI(); };

  document.getElementById('btnBgm').addEventListener('click', toggleBgm);
  document.getElementById('btnSfx').addEventListener('click', toggleSfx);
  document.getElementById('btnLang').addEventListener('click', toggleLang);
  document.getElementById('mBtnBgm').addEventListener('click', toggleBgm);
  document.getElementById('mBtnSfx').addEventListener('click', toggleSfx);
  document.getElementById('mBtnCrt').addEventListener('click', toggleCrt);
  document.getElementById('mBtnLang').addEventListener('click', toggleLang);
  document.getElementById('btnCloseSettings').addEventListener('click', () => {
    Audio8Bit.sfx.click();
    document.getElementById('settingsModal').classList.remove('open');
  });

  document.getElementById('btnBack').addEventListener('click', goBackFlow);
  document.getElementById('btnNextHint').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (state.scene === 'ENDING' && state.subBeat === 1) {
      setScene('TRIALS', 0);
    } else {
      advanceFlow();
    }
  });
  document.getElementById('dialogueText').addEventListener('click', advanceFlow);

  document.getElementById('btnTrialsStory').addEventListener('click', () => { Audio8Bit.sfx.click(); setScene('PATH', 0); });
  document.getElementById('btnTrialsReplay').addEventListener('click', () => { Audio8Bit.sfx.click(); setScene('TITLE', 0); });
  document.getElementById('btnPlayT1').addEventListener('click', () => openModuleModal(1));
  document.getElementById('btnPlayT2').addEventListener('click', () => openModuleModal(2));
  document.getElementById('btnGoGoodEnd').addEventListener('click', () => {
    state.endingType = 'good'; setScene('ENDING', 0);
  });

  document.getElementById('btnSimWin').addEventListener('click', () => handleTrialResult(state.activeModalTrial, true));
  document.getElementById('btnSimFail').addEventListener('click', () => handleTrialResult(state.activeModalTrial, false));
  document.getElementById('btnCloseMod').addEventListener('click', () => {
    Audio8Bit.sfx.click();
    document.getElementById('moduleModal').classList.remove('open');
  });

  mainCanvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    Audio8Bit.init();
    const rect = mainCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cx = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * mainCanvas.width;
    const cy = ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * mainCanvas.height;

    if (state.scene === 'TITLE') {
      advanceFlow();
    } else if (state.scene !== 'TRIALS') {
      advanceFlow();
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if ((typeof HangmanModule !== 'undefined' && HangmanModule.isOpen()) || (typeof WordleUIShell !== 'undefined' && WordleUIShell.isOpen())) return;
    if (document.getElementById('settingsModal').classList.contains('open') ||
        document.getElementById('moduleModal').classList.contains('open')) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        document.getElementById('settingsModal').classList.remove('open');
        document.getElementById('moduleModal').classList.remove('open');
      }
      return;
    }

    if (state.scene === 'LUCIFER') {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w' || e.key === 'W') {
        state.luciferCursor = 0; Audio8Bit.sfx.click(); syncLayoutUI();
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 's' || e.key === 'S') {
        state.luciferCursor = 1; Audio8Bit.sfx.click(); syncLayoutUI();
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault(); advanceFlow();
      }
      return;
    }

    if (state.scene !== 'TRIALS') {
      if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        e.preventDefault(); advanceFlow();
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'Backspace') {
        e.preventDefault(); goBackFlow();
      }
    }
  });

  // =========================================================================
  // 8. MAIN ANIMATION LOOP
  // =========================================================================
  let rafId = null;

  function loop() {
    state.tick++;
    state.sceneTick++;
    if (state.shakeFrames > 0) state.shakeFrames--;
    if (state.flashFrames > 0) state.flashFrames--;

    if (!['TITLE', 'TRIALS', 'LUCIFER'].includes(state.scene)) {
      const dlg = getActiveDialogue();
      if (dlg.text && state.typeIdx < dlg.text.length) {
        const prev = Math.floor(state.typeIdx);
        state.typeIdx = Math.min(dlg.text.length, state.typeIdx + 0.85);
        const cur = Math.floor(state.typeIdx);
        if (cur > prev) {
          document.getElementById('dialogueText').textContent = dlg.text.slice(0, cur);
        }
      }
    }

    if (state.scene === 'TRIALS') {
      pWordleCtx.clearRect(0, 0, 240, 190);
      renderWordlePreview(pWordleCtx, 240, 190);
      pHangmanCtx.clearRect(0, 0, 240, 190);
      renderHangmanPreview(pHangmanCtx, 240, 190);
    } else {
      const W = mainCanvas.width;
      const H = mainCanvas.height;
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

      if (state.scene === 'TITLE') renderTitle(ctx, W, H);
      else if (state.scene === 'HOME') renderHome(ctx, W, H, false);
      else if (state.scene === 'WOODS') renderWoods(ctx, W, H);
      else if (state.scene === 'SORROW') renderSorrow(ctx, W, H, false);
      else if (state.scene === 'LUCIFER' || state.scene === 'LUCIFER_GATE') renderLucifer(ctx, W, H);
      else if (state.scene === 'WRAITH') renderWraith(ctx, W, H);
      else if (state.scene === 'PATH') renderPath(ctx, W, H);
      else if (state.scene === 'ENDING') {
        if (state.endingType === 'good') {
          if (state.subBeat === 0) renderFireEnding(ctx, W, H, 'witch');
          else renderHome(ctx, W, H, true);
        } else {
          if (state.subBeat === 0) renderFireEnding(ctx, W, H, 'brother');
          else renderSorrow(ctx, W, H, true);
        }
      }

      if (state.flashFrames > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 240, 190, ${(state.flashFrames / 16) * 0.5})`;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      }
    }

    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }


  // =========================================================================
  // 9. INTEGRATED TRIAL 2: 2D MONOCHROME SILHOUETTE HANGMAN MODULE
  // =========================================================================
  const HangmanModule = (() => {
    // Web Audio API Eerie Horror Ambient Engine (self-contained)
    let ac = null;
    let horrorOn = true;
    let droneTimer = null;
    let droneStep = 0;
    let endTransitionTimer = null;

    const ensureAudio = () => {
      if (!ac) {
        const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
        if (AC) ac = new AC();
      }
      if (ac && ac.state === 'suspended') ac.resume().catch(() => {});
    };

    const playTone = (freq, dur, type = 'sine', vol = 0.04, delay = 0) => {
      if (!horrorOn) return;
      ensureAudio();
      if (!ac || !freq) return;
      const now = ac.currentTime + delay;
      const osc = ac.createOscillator();
      const gain = ac.createGain();
      osc.type = type;
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, now);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0005, now + dur);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ac.destination);
      osc.start(now);
      osc.stop(now + dur + 0.04);
    };

    const startAmbient = () => {
      if (droneTimer) clearInterval(droneTimer);
      // Sparse eerie haunted music-box minor notes + low wind drone
      const eerieNotes = [220, 0, 261.6, 207.7, 0, 196, 164.8, 0, 233.1, 220, 0, 146.8];
      droneStep = 0;
      droneTimer = setInterval(() => {
        if (!horrorOn || !hmState.open || !ac || ac.state !== 'running') return;
        const n = eerieNotes[droneStep % eerieNotes.length];
        if (n) playTone(n, 0.85, 'sine', 0.058, 0);
        if (droneStep % 4 === 0) playTone(73.4, 1.8, 'triangle', 0.052, 0);
        droneStep++;
      }, 650);
    };

    const stopAmbient = () => {
      if (droneTimer) { clearInterval(droneTimer); droneTimer = null; }
    };

    const hmSfx = {
      hit: () => { playTone(523, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.05, 0); playTone(659, 0.14, 'triangle', 0.045, 0.08); },
      miss: () => { playTone(145, 0.16, 'sawtooth', 0.045, 0); playTone(118, 0.24, 'sawtooth', 0.045, 0.12); },
      win: () => { [392, 493.8, 587.3, 784].forEach((f, i) => playTone(f, 0.22, 'triangle', 0.055, i * 0.11)); },
      lose: () => { [196, 185, 164.8, 130.8].forEach((f, i) => playTone(f, 0.3, 'sawtooth', 0.05, i * 0.18)); },
      click: () => playTone(320, 0.04, 'sine', 0.03),
    };

    const hmState = {
      open: false,
      view: 'HOME', // HOME, SETUP, PLAY, REVIEW
      diff: 'Easy',
      topicId: 'mystery',
      wordQueue: [],
      wordIndex: 0,      // 0..4 (5 consecutive words!)
      wordObj: null,
      guessed: new Set(),
      maxHearts: 5,
      heartsLeft: 5,
      hintUsed: false,
      roundOver: false,
      runOver: false,
      runWon: false,
      history: [], // [{w, vi, topic, diff, won}]
      reviewTab: 'words',
    };

    const overlay = document.getElementById('hangmanOverlay');

    function getDiffObj(id) {
      return DIFFS.find(d => d.id === id) || DIFFS[0];
    }

    function syncAudioBtn() {
      const btn = document.getElementById('hmBtnAudio');
      const lbl = document.getElementById('hmAudioLabel');
      btn.classList.toggle('muted', !horrorOn);
      lbl.textContent = horrorOn ? 'MUSIC: ON' : 'MUSIC: OFF';
    }

    function setView(v) {
      hmState.view = v;
      ['Home', 'Setup', 'Play', 'Review'].forEach(name => {
        document.getElementById(`hmView${name}`).classList.toggle('active', name.toUpperCase() === v);
      });
      const backBtn = document.getElementById('hmBtnBackNav');
      backBtn.textContent = v === 'HOME' ? '◄ Back to Trials' : '◄ Back';
      if (v === 'SETUP') renderSetup();
      if (v === 'REVIEW') renderReview();
    }

    function renderSetup() {
      const dg = document.getElementById('hmDiffGrid');
      dg.innerHTML = DIFFS.map(d => `
        <button class="hm-diff-btn ${hmState.diff === d.id ? 'active' : ''}" data-diff="${d.id}">${d.label}</button>
      `).join('');
      dg.querySelectorAll('[data-diff]').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          hmSfx.click();
          hmState.diff = btn.getAttribute('data-diff');
          renderSetup();
        });
      });

      const tg = document.getElementById('hmTopicGrid');
      tg.innerHTML = TOPICS.map(tp => `
        <button class="hm-topic-btn" data-topic="${tp.id}">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24">${tp.svg}</svg>
          <span>${tp.name}</span>
        </button>
      `).join('');
      tg.querySelectorAll('[data-topic]').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          hmSfx.click();
          startRun(btn.getAttribute('data-topic'));
        });
      });
    }

    function shuffle(arr) {
      const a = arr.slice();
      for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
        [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
      }
      return a;
    }

    // Start a 5-consecutive-word run with difficulty hearts (5 / 3 / 2 / 1)
    function startRun(topicId) {
      hmState.topicId = topicId;
      const dObj = getDiffObj(hmState.diff);
      hmState.maxHearts = dObj.hearts;
      hmState.heartsLeft = dObj.hearts;
      hmState.runOver = false;
      hmState.runWon = false;
      hmState.wordIndex = 0;

      const pool = (WORDS[topicId] && WORDS[topicId][hmState.diff]) ? WORDS[topicId][hmState.diff] : WORDS.mystery.Easy;
      hmState.wordQueue = shuffle(pool).slice(0, STREAK_TARGET);
      loadCurrentWord();
      setView('PLAY');
    }

    function loadCurrentWord() {
      hmState.wordObj = hmState.wordQueue[hmState.wordIndex];
      hmState.guessed = new Set();
      hmState.hintUsed = false;
      hmState.roundOver = false;

      const tp = TOPICS.find(x => x.id === hmState.topicId);
      document.getElementById('hmPlayTopic').textContent = tp ? tp.name : hmState.topicId;
      document.getElementById('hmPlayDiff').textContent = `Word ${hmState.wordIndex + 1}/${STREAK_TARGET}`;
      document.getElementById('hmHintText').textContent = `Solve ${STREAK_TARGET} words in a row before all hearts break!`;
      document.getElementById('hmBtnHint').disabled = false;
      document.getElementById('hmResultBanner').classList.remove('show');
      renderPlay();
    }

    function renderHeartsHtml() {
      let html = '<span class="hm-hearts-row" aria-label="Hearts">';
      for (let i = 0; i < hmState.maxHearts; i++) {
        const intact = i < hmState.heartsLeft;
        if (intact) {
          html += '<svg class="hm-heart-svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M12 21s-7-4.6-9.2-8.5C1.1 9.5 2.6 5.5 6.4 5.1c2.1-.2 3.8.9 5.6 2.9 1.8-2 3.5-3.1 5.6-2.9 3.8.4 5.3 4.4 3.6 7.4C19 16.4 12 21 12 21z"/></svg>';
        } else {
          // Shattered / broken monochrome outline heart
          html += '<svg class="hm-heart-svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#7c8087" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="3 2"><path d="M12 21s-7-4.6-9.2-8.5C1.1 9.5 2.6 5.5 6.4 5.1c2.1-.2 3.8.9 5.6 2.9 1.8-2 3.5-3.1 5.6-2.9 3.8.4 5.3 4.4 3.6 7.4C19 16.4 12 21 12 21z"/><polyline points="12 8 10 12 13 14 11 19"/></svg>';
        }
      }
      html += '</span>';
      return html;
    }

    function renderPlay() {
      document.getElementById('hmPlayLives').innerHTML = renderHeartsHtml();

      // Map lost hearts proportionally onto the 6-stroke 2D Hangman gallows
      const lost = hmState.maxHearts - hmState.heartsLeft;
      const strokes = hmState.heartsLeft <= 0 ? 6 : Math.round((lost / hmState.maxHearts) * 6);
      for (let i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
        document.getElementById(`hmPart${i}`).style.display = i <= strokes ? 'block' : 'none';
      }

      const word = hmState.wordObj.w;
      const row = document.getElementById('hmWordRow');
      row.innerHTML = word.split('').map(ch => {
        const found = hmState.guessed.has(ch);
        const show = found || hmState.roundOver || hmState.runOver;
        const cls = !found && (hmState.roundOver || hmState.runOver) ? 'hm-slot missed' : 'hm-slot';
        return `<div class="${cls}">${show ? ch : ''}</div>`;
      }).join('');

      const kb = document.getElementById('hmKeyboard');
      kb.innerHTML = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'.split('').map(ch => {
        const used = hmState.guessed.has(ch);
        const cls = used ? (word.includes(ch) ? 'hm-key hit' : 'hm-key miss') : 'hm-key';
        return `<button class="${cls}" data-ch="${ch}" ${(used || hmState.roundOver || hmState.runOver) ? 'disabled' : ''}>${ch}</button>`;
      }).join('');
      kb.querySelectorAll('[data-ch]').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => guessLetter(btn.getAttribute('data-ch')));
      });
    }

    function useAiHint() {
      if (hmState.roundOver || hmState.runOver || hmState.hintUsed) return;
      hmState.hintUsed = true;
      hmSfx.click();
      const obj = hmState.wordObj;
      let msg = '';
      if (hmState.diff === 'Easy') {
        const unguessed = obj.w.split('').filter(c => !hmState.guessed.has(c));
        if (unguessed.length > 1) hmState.guessed.add(unguessed[0]);
        msg = `[Easy AI] ${obj.d} (${obj.vi}) — Revealed "${unguessed[0] || ''}".`;
      } else if (hmState.diff === 'Medium') {
        msg = `[Medium AI] ${obj.d} (${obj.vi}).`;
      } else if (hmState.diff === 'Hard') {
        msg = `[Hard AI] Clue: ${obj.r}.`;
      } else {
        msg = `[Extreme AI] Cryptic: ${obj.r.split(' ').slice(0, 4).join(' ')}... (${obj.w.length} letters)`;
      }
      document.getElementById('hmHintText').textContent = msg;
      document.getElementById('hmBtnHint').disabled = true;
      renderPlay();
    }

    function guessLetter(ch) {
      if (hmState.roundOver || hmState.runOver || hmState.guessed.has(ch)) return;
      hmState.guessed.add(ch);
      const word = hmState.wordObj.w;

      if (word.includes(ch)) {
        hmSfx.hit();
        const solved = word.split('').every(c => hmState.guessed.has(c));
        if (solved) handleWordSolved();
      } else {
        hmState.heartsLeft = Math.max(0, hmState.heartsLeft - 1);
        hmSfx.miss();
        if (hmState.heartsLeft <= 0) handleAllHeartsBroken();
      }
      renderPlay();
    }
