    const ADJ_WORDS = new Set(['BRAVE','HAPPY','ANGRY','PROUD','CALM','CURIOUS','ANXIOUS','GRATEFUL','JEALOUS','PATIENT','CONFIDENT','OPTIMISTIC','RELUCTANT','EMPATHETIC','AMBIVALENT','HAUNTED','TAILORED','MACABRE','OMINOUS']);

    function getWordStudyInfo(obj) {
      const w = obj.w;
      const ipa = IPA_MAP[w] || `/${w.toLowerCase()}/`;
      const lower = w.toLowerCase();
      let usage = '';
      if (w === 'SWIM') usage = `Usage: "We swim every morning to build stamina."`;
      else if (ADJ_WORDS.has(w)) usage = `Usage: "She stayed ${lower} even when the forest grew dark."`;
      else usage = `Usage: "In this context, '${lower}' refers to ${obj.d.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + obj.d.slice(1)}."`;
      return { ipa, usage };
    }

    function speakEnglishWord(word) {
      try {
        if ('speechSynthesis' in window) {
          window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
          const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(word.toLowerCase());
          u.lang = 'en-US';
          u.rate = 0.9;
          window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    function buildVocabCardHtml(obj) {
      const info = getWordStudyInfo(obj);
      return `
        <div class="hm-vocab-card">
          <div class="hm-vocab-head">
            <div>
              <span class="hm-vocab-word">${obj.w}</span>
              <span class="hm-vocab-ipa">${info.ipa}</span>
            </div>
            <button class="hm-btn-mono dark" id="hmBtnSpeak" style="padding:3px 7px;font-size:10px;">Pronounce</button>
          </div>
          <div class="hm-vocab-row"><strong>Meaning:</strong> ${obj.vi} (${obj.d})</div>
          <div class="hm-vocab-ex">${info.usage}</div>
        </div>`;
    }

    function recordHistory(won) {
      const tp = TOPICS.find(x => x.id === hmState.topicId);
      hmState.history.unshift({
        w: hmState.wordObj.w,
        vi: hmState.wordObj.vi,
        topic: tp ? tp.name : hmState.topicId,
        diff: hmState.diff,
        won,
      });
    }

    function handleWordSolved() {
      hmState.roundOver = true;
      recordHistory(true);

      const banner = document.getElementById('hmResultBanner');
      const title = document.getElementById('hmResultTitle');
      const sub = document.getElementById('hmResultSub');
      const actions = document.getElementById('hmResultActions');

      hmSfx.win();
      sub.innerHTML = buildVocabCardHtml(hmState.wordObj);
      const spk = document.getElementById('hmBtnSpeak');
      if (spk) spk.addEventListener('click', () => speakEnglishWord(hmState.wordObj.w));

      if (hmState.wordIndex + 1 >= STREAK_TARGET) {
        hmState.runOver = true;
        hmState.runWon = true;
        title.textContent = `5/5 WORDS SOLVED! (${hmState.heartsLeft}/${hmState.maxHearts} Hearts Left)`;
        actions.innerHTML = `<button class="hm-btn-mono" id="hmActToGoodEnd">Continue to Ending ▸</button>`;
        document.getElementById('hmActToGoodEnd').addEventListener('click', () => {
          close();
          state.trials.t1 = true;
          state.trials.t2 = true;
          state.endingType = 'good';
          setScene('ENDING', 0);
        });
      } else {
        title.textContent = `WORD ${hmState.wordIndex + 1}/${STREAK_TARGET} SOLVED!`;
        actions.innerHTML = `<button class="hm-btn-mono" id="hmActNextWord">Next Word (${hmState.wordIndex + 2}/${STREAK_TARGET}) ▸</button>`;
        document.getElementById('hmActNextWord').addEventListener('click', () => {
          hmSfx.click();
          hmState.wordIndex++;
          loadCurrentWord();
        });
      }
      banner.classList.add('show');
    }

    function handleAllHeartsBroken() {
      hmState.roundOver = true;
      hmState.runOver = true;
      hmState.runWon = false;
      recordHistory(false);
      hmSfx.lose();

      const banner = document.getElementById('hmResultBanner');
      const title = document.getElementById('hmResultTitle');
      const sub = document.getElementById('hmResultSub');
      const actions = document.getElementById('hmResultActions');

      title.textContent = `ALL HEARTS SHATTERED (Word ${hmState.wordIndex + 1}/${STREAK_TARGET})`;
      sub.innerHTML = buildVocabCardHtml(hmState.wordObj);
      const spk = document.getElementById('hmBtnSpeak');
      if (spk) spk.addEventListener('click', () => speakEnglishWord(hmState.wordObj.w));

      actions.innerHTML = `<button class="hm-btn-mono" id="hmActToBadEnd">Continue to Ending ▸</button>`;
      document.getElementById('hmActToBadEnd').addEventListener('click', () => {
        close();
        handleTrialResult(2, false);
      });
      banner.classList.add('show');
    }

    function renderReview() {
      const body = document.getElementById('hmReviewBody');
      document.getElementById('hmTabWords').classList.toggle('active', hmState.reviewTab === 'words');
      document.getElementById('hmTabRules').classList.toggle('active', hmState.reviewTab === 'rules');

      if (hmState.reviewTab === 'rules') {
        body.innerHTML = `
          <div class="hm-review-card">
            <strong>5-Word Streak Goal:</strong> Solve <strong>5 consecutive English words</strong> while keeping at least 1 heart intact to unlock the <strong>Good Ending (BURN THE WITCH)</strong>.
          </div>
          <div class="hm-review-card">
            <strong>4 Difficulty Heart Limits:</strong><br/>
            • <strong>Easy:</strong> 5 Hearts (5 misses)<br/>
            • <strong>Medium:</strong> 3 Hearts (3 misses)<br/>
            • <strong>Hard:</strong> 2 Hearts (2 misses)<br/>
            • <strong>Extremely Hard:</strong> 1 Heart (1 miss = instant defeat)
          </div>
          <div class="hm-review-card">
            <strong>Shattered Hearts:</strong> Each wrong letter breaks 1 heart and draws the hanging figure. If all hearts shatter, you trigger the <strong>Bad Ending (BURN THE BROTHER)</strong>.
          </div>`;
      } else if (hmState.history.length === 0) {
        body.innerHTML = `<div class="hm-review-card">No words played yet. Press <strong>start</strong> to begin your 5-word challenge and build your study list!</div>`;
      } else {
        body.innerHTML = hmState.history.map(item => {
          const ipa = IPA_MAP[item.w] || '';
          return `
          <div class="hm-review-card">
            <strong>${item.w}</strong> <span style="font-style:italic;color:#4a4d54;">${ipa}</span> — ${item.vi}<br/>
            <span style="font-size:11px;color:#4a4d54;">${item.topic} • ${item.diff} • ${item.won ? 'Solved' : 'Missed'}</span>
          </div>`;
        }).join('');
      }
    }

    function open() {
      hmState.open = true;
      overlay.classList.add('open');
      ensureAudio();
      syncAudioBtn();
      startAmbient();
      setView('HOME');
    }

    function close() {
      if (endTransitionTimer) { clearTimeout(endTransitionTimer); endTransitionTimer = null; }
      hmState.open = false;
      stopAmbient();
      overlay.classList.remove('open');
    }

    // Wire Hangman controls
    document.getElementById('hmBtnStart').addEventListener('click', () => { hmSfx.click(); setView('SETUP'); });
    document.getElementById('hmBtnReview').addEventListener('click', () => { hmSfx.click(); setView('REVIEW'); });
    document.getElementById('hmBtnHint').addEventListener('click', useAiHint);
    document.getElementById('hmTabWords').addEventListener('click', () => { hmSfx.click(); hmState.reviewTab = 'words'; renderReview(); });
    document.getElementById('hmTabRules').addEventListener('click', () => { hmSfx.click(); hmState.reviewTab = 'rules'; renderReview(); });

    document.getElementById('hmBtnAudio').addEventListener('click', () => {
      horrorOn = !horrorOn;
      if (horrorOn) { ensureAudio(); hmSfx.click(); }
      syncAudioBtn();
    });

    document.getElementById('hmBtnBackNav').addEventListener('click', () => {
      hmSfx.click();
      if (hmState.view === 'HOME') { close(); setScene('TRIALS', 0); }
      else if (hmState.view === 'PLAY') setView('SETUP');
      else setView('HOME');
    });

    // Physical keyboard support inside Hangman
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (!hmState.open) return;
      if (e.key === 'Escape') { close(); return; }
      if (hmState.view === 'PLAY' && /^[a-zA-Z]$/.test(e.key)) {
        guessLetter(e.key.toUpperCase());
      }
    });

    return { open, close, isOpen: () => hmState.open };
  })();

  // Connect Trial 2 directly to our 2D Monochrome Silhouette Hangman!
  window.GameBridge.onLaunchTrial2 = () => setScene('LUCIFER_GATE', 0);


  // =========================================================================
  // 10. INTEGRATED TRIAL 1: WORDLE UI SHELL (Arcade CRT Start -> Pixel Board)
  // =========================================================================
  const WordleUIShell = (() => {
    const overlay = document.getElementById('wordleOverlay');
    const scrStart = document.getElementById('wdScreenStart');
    const scrBoard = document.getElementById('wdScreenBoard');
    const gridEl = document.getElementById('wdGrid');
    const kbEl = document.getElementById('wdKeyboard');
    const noteEl = document.getElementById('wdShellNote');

    const wdState = {
      open: false,
      screen: 'START', // START | BOARD
      readyIdx: 0,     // 0=YES, 1=NO
      row: 0,
      col: 0,
      cells: Array.from({ length: 6 }, () => Array(5).fill('')),
    };

    function setScreen(scr) {
      wdState.screen = scr;
      scrStart.classList.toggle('active', scr === 'START');
      scrBoard.classList.toggle('active', scr === 'BOARD');
      if (scr === 'BOARD') {
        renderGrid();
        renderKeyboard();
      }
    }

    function syncReadyChoice() {
      document.getElementById('wdBtnYes').classList.toggle('active', wdState.readyIdx === 0);
      document.getElementById('wdBtnNo').classList.toggle('active', wdState.readyIdx === 1);
    }

    function renderGrid() {
      let html = '';
      for (let r = 0; r < 6; r++) {
        for (let c = 0; c < 5; c++) {
          const ch = wdState.cells[r][c];
          const isCur = (r === wdState.row && c === wdState.col);
          html += `<div class="wd-tile ${isCur ? 'active-cell' : ''}">${ch}</div>`;
        }
      }
      gridEl.innerHTML = html;
    }

    function handleKey(k) {
      Audio8Bit.sfx.click();
      if (k === '<') {
        if (wdState.col > 0) {
          wdState.col--;
          wdState.cells[wdState.row][wdState.col] = '';
        }
      } else if (k === 'GO') {
        if (wdState.col === 5 && wdState.row < 5) {
          wdState.row++;
          wdState.col = 0;
          noteEl.textContent = 'Row submitted (Teammate 1 logic hooks here)';
        } else {
          noteEl.textContent = 'Type 5 letters — UI Shell preview mode';
        }
      } else if (/^[A-Z]$/.test(k)) {
        if (wdState.col < 5) {
          wdState.cells[wdState.row][wdState.col] = k;
          wdState.col++;
        }
      }
      renderGrid();
    }

    function renderKeyboard() {
      const rows = [
        ['Q','W','E','R','T','Y','U','I','O','P'],
        ['A','S','D','F','G','H','J','K','L'],
        ['GO','Z','X','C','V','B','N','M','<']
      ];
      kbEl.innerHTML = rows.map(r => `
        <div class="wd-kb-row">
          ${r.map(k => `<button class="wd-key ${(k === 'GO' || k === '<') ? 'wide' : ''}" data-wk="${k}">${k}</button>`).join('')}
        </div>`).join('');
      kbEl.querySelectorAll('[data-wk]').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => handleKey(btn.getAttribute('data-wk')));
      });
    }

    function resetBoard() {
      wdState.row = 0;
      wdState.col = 0;
      wdState.cells = Array.from({ length: 6 }, () => Array(5).fill(''));
      noteEl.textContent = 'UI Shell — Ready for Teammate 1 Wordle Logic';
      renderGrid();
    }

    function open() {
      wdState.open = true;
      wdState.readyIdx = 0;
      overlay.classList.add('open');
      syncReadyChoice();
      setScreen('START');
    }

    function close() {
      wdState.open = false;
      overlay.classList.remove('open');
    }

    document.getElementById('wdBtnYes').addEventListener('click', () => {
      Audio8Bit.sfx.confirm();
      resetBoard();
      setScreen('BOARD');
    });
    document.getElementById('wdBtnNo').addEventListener('click', () => {
      Audio8Bit.sfx.click();
      close();
    });
    document.getElementById('wdBtnBackHub1').addEventListener('click', () => {
      Audio8Bit.sfx.click();
      close();
    });
    document.getElementById('wdBtnBackStart').addEventListener('click', () => {
      Audio8Bit.sfx.click();
      setScreen('START');
    });
    document.getElementById('wdBtnInfo').addEventListener('click', () => {
      Audio8Bit.sfx.click();
      noteEl.textContent = 'Wordle UI Shell: Teammate 1 will plug word-checking logic here.';
    });
    document.getElementById('wdBtnClearDemo').addEventListener('click', () => {
      Audio8Bit.sfx.click();
      resetBoard();
    });
    document.getElementById('wdBtnMarkDone').addEventListener('click', () => {
      close();
      handleTrialResult(1, true);
    });

    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (!wdState.open) return;
      if (e.key === 'Escape') { close(); return; }
      if (wdState.screen === 'START') {
        if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') { wdState.readyIdx = 0; Audio8Bit.sfx.click(); syncReadyChoice(); }
        else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'D') { wdState.readyIdx = 1; Audio8Bit.sfx.click(); syncReadyChoice(); }
        else if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (wdState.readyIdx === 0) { Audio8Bit.sfx.confirm(); resetBoard(); setScreen('BOARD'); }
          else { Audio8Bit.sfx.click(); close(); }
        }
      } else if (wdState.screen === 'BOARD') {
        if (e.key === 'Backspace') handleKey('<');
        else if (e.key === 'Enter') handleKey('GO');
        else if (/^[a-zA-Z]$/.test(e.key)) handleKey(e.key.toUpperCase());
      }
    });

    return { open, close, isOpen: () => wdState.open };
  })();

  window.GameBridge.onLaunchTrial1 = () => WordleUIShell.open();

  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    setScene('TITLE', 0);
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
